enemy.en: All of a sudden, the enemy bombs came down on us like rain.
enemy.zh: 突然，敌人的炸弹像雨点一样落向我们。

behave.en: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
behave.zh: 其他人的期望会影响我们的行为。

bite.en: If you bite me, I'll bite you back.
bite.zh: 如果你咬我，我就咬回来。

trust.en: I didn't trust Tom and he didn't trust me, either.
trust.zh: 我不信任汤姆而且汤姆也不信任我。

rope.en: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
rope.zh: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。

pulse.zh: 再检查一下汤姆的脉搏。

choose.en: You may choose whichever book you like.
choose.zh: 你可以选择任何你喜欢的书。

christmas.en: Tom and I've decided not to go to Australia for Christmas this year.
christmas.zh: 我和汤姆决定今年圣诞节不去澳大利亚了。

touch.en: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
touch.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

deal.en: It hasn't been easy for Tom to deal with Mary's health problems.
deal.zh: 处理玛丽的健康问题对汤姆来说不容易。

phone.en: Tom wanted Mary's phone number, but she refused to give it to him.
phone.zh: 汤姆想要玛丽的电话号码但是被拒绝了。

notice.en: Tom didn't notice that Mary had a new hairstyle.
notice.zh: 汤姆没注意到玛莉换了新发型。

surgery.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
surgery.zh: 大部份的保险计划不包含整容手术。

lucky.en: It was lucky for you that you found it.

anyone.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
anyone.zh: 我知道不太可能有人愿意帮助我。

planet.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
planet.zh: 水星是我们的太阳系中最小的行星。

okay.en: Stop pretending that everything's okay. It's not.
okay.zh: 不要再假装一切都好了，不是这样的！

spoon.en: Tom dropped the spoon into his pocket.
spoon.zh: 汤姆把汤匙放进了口袋。

god.en: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
god.zh: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

waste.en: Tom told Mary not to waste her time trying to convince John to help.
waste.zh: 汤姆对玛丽说，不要浪费时间去说服约翰来帮忙。

sweat.en: He wiped the sweat from his face.

cold.en: My fingers are so numb with cold that I can't play the piano.
cold.zh: 我的手指冻僵了，以至于无法弹钢琴了。

suit.en: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
suit.zh: 汤姆只在特殊场合穿西装。

truth.en: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
truth.zh: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。

idiot.en: He even called me an idiot.

bill.en: The bill was passed after a hard fight in the House.
bill.zh: 该法案在众议院争议后获得通过。

mess.en: My brother's room is always a mess.
mess.zh: 我弟弟的房间总是很乱。

complex.en: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?
complex.zh: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？

reply.en: Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.
reply.zh: 收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。

test.en: Tom didn't have enough time to answer all the questions on the test.
test.zh: 汤姆考试时没时间答完所有题。

admit.en: I admit that this may not be the best way of doing it.
admit.zh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。

fond.en: My grandfather is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.
fond.zh: 我的爷爷喜欢大清早的散步。

beg.zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？

alone.en: It says in the Bible, "Man shall not live on bread alone."
alone.zh: 圣经里有一句话，叫做“人不能只靠面包生活”。

hardly.en: She could hardly keep from laughing when she saw the dress.
hardly.zh: 当她看到那件衣服, 她无法抑制自己的笑声。

soccer.en: His little brother is a famous soccer player.
soccer.zh: 他弟弟是个有名的足球选手。

afford.en: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
afford.zh: 法国是一个福利国家，但它却不再能够负担得起了。

calm.en: I was calm until I saw the syringe.
calm.zh: 看到针管儿之前我一直都很淡定。

accept.en: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
accept.zh: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。

blame.en: None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
blame.zh: 我们都不认为他是事故的罪魁祸首。

wine.en: I'd like to have this meat dish with your best white wine.
wine.zh: 我想喝著你最好的白酒吃这肉。

regret.en: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
regret.zh: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。

doubt.en: I doubt that Tom will ever learn how to speak French properly.
doubt.zh: 我对汤姆要持之以恒地学习法语口语这件事很怀疑。

bee.en: Bee stings can be very painful.
bee.zh: 蜜蜂螫人可以是非常痛苦的。

nightmare.en: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
nightmare.zh: 我觉得我好像从恶梦中惊醒。

hate.en: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.

headache.en: I've had a headache for three days and I can't get rid of it.
headache.zh: 我已经头疼三天了，还没摆脱它。

proposal.en: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
proposal.zh: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。

opinion.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
opinion.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

jazz.en: Tom started playing jazz after studying classical music for many years.
jazz.zh: 在学习古典音乐多年后，汤姆开始演奏爵士了。

truck.en: Tom was admiring my new car at the time the truck crashed into it.
truck.zh: 在汤姆欣赏我的新车的同时，一辆卡车撞了过来。

luggage.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
luggage.zh: 先生，我们可以检查一下您的行李吗？

space.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.
space.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。

owe.en: I owe it you that I am still alive.

pants.en: I want to buy a pair of pants.

saw.en: I haven't seen you for ages. Do you remember when I saw you last?
saw.zh: 好久不见了。记得上次我什么时候看见你的吗？

sunrise.en: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.
sunrise.zh: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。

thought.en: Tom said he thought he might be the only one who had to do that.
thought.zh: 汤姆说他以为需要做那件事的就只有他一个。

highway.en: The accident took place on the highway.
highway.zh: 事故发生在高速公路上。

escape.en: He looked for every possible means of escape.
escape.zh: 他寻找一切可能的逃生途径。

win.en: Tom did a good job predicting who would win the election.
win.zh: 汤姆很会预测选举结果。

reading.en: I'll have finished reading this novel by the time you come tomorrow.
reading.zh: 你明天来的时候，我就看完这本小说了。

helmet.en: You need to wear a helmet.
helmet.zh: 你需要戴安全帽。你需要戴头盔。

feed.en: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
feed.zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

patient.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
patient.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。

being.en: For the time being, I'm studying French at this language school.
being.zh: 目前，我正在这所语言学校学习法语。

lose.en: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
lose.zh: 最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。

pray.en: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
pray.zh: 现在我们什么也做不了，救不了汤姆。我们唯一能做的就是祈祷。

smart.en: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.
smart.zh: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。

sore.en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
sore.zh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

sort.en: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.
sort.zh: 他在城市里一直受到噪音或者其他的干扰。

ignore.en: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
ignore.zh: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。

pure.en: The sample is not pure enough.

gold.en: In 1848, people came to California to dig for gold.

bath.en: I was having a bath when the telephone rang.
bath.zh: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

secret.en: This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
secret.zh: 这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。

ridiculous.en: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
ridiculous.zh: 花光他们所有的钱会很荒谬。

video.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
video.zh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

fault.en: He is constantly finding fault with other people.

human.en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
human.zh: 无须多言，基本人权应当被尊重。

nature.en: She expressed her feelings for nature in a poem.
nature.zh: 她通过一首诗表达了她对大自然的感受。

dream.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
dream.zh: 你曾经梦想在天空飞翔吗？

pretty.en: I have a pretty good idea who Tom will be hanging out with tonight.
pretty.zh: 我大概知道汤姆今晚会和谁一起玩。

special.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
special.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

shake.en: She stepped forward to shake his hand.
shake.zh: 为了握住他的手，她往前跨了一步。

shoulder.en: She rested her head on her mother's shoulder.
shoulder.zh: 她把头枕在母亲的肩膀上。

contact.en: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
contact.zh: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。

forgive.en: Tom is never going to forgive me, is he?
forgive.zh: 汤姆永远也不会原谅我了，是吗？

wrap.en: Please wrap it like a Christmas present.
wrap.zh: 请把它包装得像一个圣诞礼物。

pretend.en: There's no need to pretend anymore.

search.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
search.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。

shame.en: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.
shame.zh: 这简直是太可惜了，他们没有买火险。

unhappy.en: Tom said that he thought that Mary was unhappy in Boston.
unhappy.zh: 汤姆说他以为玛丽在波士顿不快乐。

upstairs.en: Go upstairs and bring down my trunk.
upstairs.zh: 上楼把我的旅行箱拿下来。

shut.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
shut.zh: 婚前张开眼，婚后半闭眼。

wood.en: "What kind of wood is that?" "It's spruce."

impossible.en: It's impossible to do the sights of Tokyo in a day or two.
impossible.zh: 一两天是没办法逛完东京的。

clock.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
clock.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

fight.en: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
fight.zh: 抱著失败主义的态度你无法打一场漂亮的仗。

broken.en: They accused me of having broken my promise.
broken.zh: 他们指责我没有信守诺言。

pain.en: Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
pain.zh: 汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。

soup.en: A good cook doesn't throw out yesterday's soup.
soup.zh: 一个好的厨师不会丢掉昨天的汤。

thick.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.
thick.zh: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。

system.en: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
system.zh: 我很高兴他们修复了暖气系统，但现在太热了。

trunk.en: Go upstairs and bring down my trunk.
trunk.zh: 上楼把我的旅行箱拿下来。

worst.en: Leaving something unfinished is the worst thing you can do.
worst.zh: 半途而废是你所能做的最糟糕的事情。

strike.en: We're on strike because the company hasn't improved our wages.
strike.zh: 我们罢工是因为公司没有改善我们的工资。

danger.en: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.

miracle.en: I can hope for a miracle, can't I?
miracle.zh: 我能等奇迹发生，是不是？

delicious.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
delicious.zh: 餐厅的饭很便宜，而且很好吃。

real.en: Problems that can be solved with money are not real problems.
real.zh: 钱可以解决的问题都不是问题。

treat.en: Why do you let Tom treat you that way?
treat.zh: 你为甚么让汤姆那么对待你？

hero.en: He dreamed of being a hero.
hero.zh: 他梦想着成为一名英雄。

recently.en: Even though I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
recently.zh: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。

heavily.en: I had hardly left home when it began to rain heavily.
heavily.zh: 当雨开始下得很大的时候, 我几乎不能出门了。

pale.en: He told me that I looked pale and asked me what the matter was.
pale.zh: 他跟我说我很苍白，并问我怎么了。

guy.en: Women eat lighter meals when they're eating with a guy.
guy.zh: 当女性跟一个男人吃饭时，女性会吃得比较少。

magician.en: I have a friend whose father is a magician.
magician.zh: 我有一个父亲是魔术师的朋友。

foolish.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
foolish.zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

knit.en: Tom tried to convince Mary to knit him a scarf.
knit.zh: 汤姆想说服玛丽给他织一条围巾。

choice.en: Because of the storm, we had no choice but to stay at home.
choice.zh: 因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

progress.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
progress.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。

crazy.en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
crazy.zh: 你是怎么想到这么疯狂的主意的？

slowly.en: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?

retire.en: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.
retire.zh: 我希望在六十岁时退休。

liquid.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
liquid.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

battle.en: This is the place where the battle of Hastings took place.
battle.zh: 这里是黑斯廷斯战役发生的地方。

against.en: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
against.zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

war.en: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.
war.zh: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。

risk.en: It's a risk that Tom and I aren't willing to take.
risk.zh: 我和汤姆都不愿意冒这个险。

part.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
part.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

serious.en: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.
serious.zh: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。

major.en: What do you plan to major in at college?
major.zh: 你计划去大学后主修什么吗？

born.en: I live in Boston, but I was born in Chicago.
born.zh: 我住在波士顿，但我出生在芝加哥。

marry.en: I told him, once and for all, that I would not marry him.
marry.zh: 我告诉他，我永远不会嫁给他。

stupid.en: I didn't think Tom would be stupid enough to do that.
stupid.zh: 我觉得，汤姆不会傻到那样做。

fever.en: Do you have a fever and a sore throat?

error.en: "There's an apostrophe missing. It's and its are different." "I know. It was a typing error."
error.zh: “你漏写了一个撇号。it's和its是有分别的。” “我知道。是我打错了。”

modest.en: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.
modest.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖后，她仍谦虚如昔。

alert.en: A tsunami is coming, so please be on the alert.

sale.en: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
sale.zh: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百货公司的特价活动。

bachelor.en: Tom remained a bachelor until his death.

mad.en: Her eyes shone with joy when she saw that her mother was not mad at her.
mad.zh: 当她看到妈妈没在生她的气，她的双眼因为幸福而闪烁了。

control.en: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
control.zh: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。

hurt.en: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.
hurt.zh: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。

taste.en: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.
taste.zh: 刚开始的时候你可能不会喜欢这个啤酒。这是需要多次品尝去习惯它的口味。

count.en: Tom closed his eyes and began to count sheep.
count.zh: 汤姆闭上了眼睛开始数羊。

alive.en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
alive.zh: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。

drunk.en: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.
drunk.zh: 喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。

grab.en: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?

remote.en: The TV remote control is under the couch.
remote.zh: 电视遥控器在沙发下面。

found.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
found.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。

neck.en: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
neck.zh: 他大喊的时候，脖子上青筋暴起。

golf.en: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
golf.zh: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。

lay.en: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
lay.zh: 森林外有一个美丽的湖泊。

adventure.en: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
adventure.zh: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。

affection.en: Everyone knows of his affection for that dog.
affection.zh: 人人都知道他对那狗的感情。

bicycle.en: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
bicycle.zh: 你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？

skin.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
skin.zh: 鲨鱼皮比金枪鱼皮粗糙多了。

smooth.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.

gray.en: My office is on the fourth floor of that gray six-story building.
gray.zh: 我的办公室在那幢灰色的六层楼的四楼。

baggage.en: How many pieces of baggage do you have?

closet.en: Tom hung his jacket in the hall closet.
closet.zh: 汤姆把夹克挂在大厅衣柜里。

hide.en: It was difficult for him to hide his pride in his success.
hide.zh: 他很难掩饰对自己成功的骄傲。

feeling.en: After a couple of drinks, the guy was feeling no pain.
feeling.zh: 喝了几杯酒后，这个家伙就感觉不痛了。

offer.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
offer.zh: 如果您同意, 我想给他这份工作。

completely.en: The leaves of the trees in the garden have turned completely red.
completely.zh: 花园里树上的叶子已经完全变红了。

business.en: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
business.zh: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。

deserve.en: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.
deserve.zh: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。

death.en: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
death.zh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

fear.en: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.
fear.zh: 不要害怕意外，但要有准备。

weed.en: Tom said he thought he'd be able to help Mary weed the garden today.
weed.zh: 汤姆说他以为他今天能够帮玛丽的花园除草

comfortable.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.

follow.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
follow.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

tire.en: Could you check the tire pressure?
tire.zh: 你能检查一下这个轮胎的气压吗？

flat.en: My bicycle has a flat tire.
flat.zh: 我的脚踏车轮胎没气了。

cap.en: I paid ten dollars for this cap.
cap.zh: 我付了十美元买这顶帽子。

strength.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
strength.zh: 战士知道自己的力量和弱点。

paint.en: He had his sister help him paint the wall of his room.
paint.zh: 他让妹妹帮他涂他房间的墙。

address.en: He said that if he knew her address, he would write to her.
address.zh: 他说如果他知道她的地址，他会写信给她。

lead.en: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
lead.zh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

mathematics.en: Mathematics is an easy subject for me.
mathematics.zh: 数学对我来说是一个容易的科目。

advice.en: None of this would've been necessary if we'd followed Tom's advice.
advice.zh: 如果我们照了汤姆的话去做这一切都是没必要的。

chance.en: I hope I will have a chance to see you next time I'm in New York.
chance.zh: 希望下次我在纽约还可以有机会见到你。

butter.en: I like to eat honey and peanut butter sandwiches.
butter.zh: 我喜欢吃蜂蜜花生酱三明治。

camera.en: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
camera.zh: 人会因为体温而在红外线摄影机上显现。

nervous.en: I'm the type who gets nervous in front of people, so I'm bad at speech making.
nervous.zh: 我是那种面对人群很紧张的人，所以我的演讲能力很差。

success.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
success.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

later.en: Tom is going to be coming here later this afternoon.
later.zh: 汤姆今天下午会来这里。

beginning.en: I hope that this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
beginning.zh: 希望这是美好友谊的开始。

movie.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
movie.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

dictator.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
dictator.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。

balcony.en: The family is eating breakfast on the balcony.
balcony.zh: 一家人在阳台上吃早饭。

ignorance.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
ignorance.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

practical.en: He was an intelligent and practical man.

worse.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
worse.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

fix.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.
fix.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。

joke.en: Tom meant it as a joke, but nobody laughed.
joke.zh: 汤姆认为那是个玩笑，但是没人笑。

windy.en: When it's windy, the leaves of the old oak rustle and its branches creak.
windy.zh: 刮风的时候，老橡树的叶子会沙沙作响，树枝会发出嘎吱声。

decision.en: His decision to retire surprised all of us.
decision.zh: 他要退休的决定让我们都感到吃惊。

knowledge.en: He doesn't have any knowledge about American democracy.
knowledge.zh: 他一点都不知道美国的民主。

power.en: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
power.zh: 纽约帝国大厦现在完全依靠风力发电。

handle.en: I don't know how to handle children.
handle.zh: 我不知道如何对待孩子。

mirror.en: How many times a day do you look at yourself in the mirror?

exist.en: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
exist.zh: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。

shot.en: I shot the horse because it had trouble breathing.
shot.zh: 我枪杀了那匹马，因为他已呼吸困难。

stomach.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
stomach.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

missing.en: Tom thinks I'm missing this great opportunity.
missing.zh: 汤姆觉得我要错过这大好机会了。

official.zh: 汤姆不是选出来的官员。

obey.en: They don't always obey their parents.
obey.zh: 他们并不总是服从他们的父母。

easily.en: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
easily.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

shoot.en: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
shoot.zh: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。

remove.en: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
remove.zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。

saturn.zh: 许多卫星绕著土星运行。

clever.en: He looks like a clever boy.
clever.zh: 他看起来像是个聪明的男孩。

cake.en: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
cake.zh: 蛋糕应该差不多可以出炉了。

coat.en: That coat may have cost a lot of money, but it's worth it.
coat.zh: 那件大衣可能需要很多钱，但它值得。

area.en: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
area.zh: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。

hit.en: When Dad finds out what you've done, he's going to hit the roof.
hit.zh: 当爸爸发现你做了什么的时候，他会发疯的。

damage.en: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.
damage.zh: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。

fridge.en: Get yourself something to eat from the fridge.
fridge.zh: 你去冰箱拿点东西吃吧。

lid.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

lock.en: If I lost my key, I wouldn't be able to lock the door.
lock.zh: 如果我弄丢了我的钥匙，我就无法锁门了。

thief.en: Give a thief enough rope and he'll hang himself.

fake.en: I think Tom is going to be pretty mad when he finds out that the painting he bought is a fake.
fake.zh: 我觉得当汤姆发现他买来的画是赝品的时候，他会很生气。

peace.en: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
peace.zh: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。

familiar.en: All of you are familiar with the truth of the story.
familiar.zh: 你们所有的人都熟悉这个故事的真相。

ugly.en: An ugly man knocked on my door.
ugly.zh: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。

fork.en: We've come to a fork in the road.

project.en: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
project.zh: 该公司在这个企划中投入了很多钱。

surprising.en: I've something interesting to tell you that you might find surprising.
surprising.zh: 告诉你个好玩的事，能惊你一下。

tiger.en: Rather than live a hundred years as a rabbit, live one day as a tiger.
tiger.zh: 宁可当只老虎活一天，也不愿当只兔子过一百年。

finger.en: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.
finger.zh: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。

active.en: The volcano has become active again.
active.zh: 这座火山又开始活动了。

upset.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
upset.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

angel.en: This morning, I saw an angel.

learned.en: It was an advantage having learned Chinese while I was in school.
learned.zh: 在学校时我学了中文是个优势。

revenge.en: They set fire to their neighbor's house in revenge.
revenge.zh: 为了报仇，他们放火烧了邻居的家。

asleep.en: He was about to fall asleep, when he heard his name called.
asleep.zh: 他快要睡著的时候，听到有人在叫他的名字。

fell.en: Ever since she fell in the kitchen, she hasn't been all there.
fell.zh: 自从她在厨房里摔倒后，她不曾再到那里。

staff.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
staff.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

conservative.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.
conservative.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。

coincidence.en: Tom doesn't think this is a coincidence.
coincidence.zh: 汤姆不认为这是一个巧合。

awful.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
awful.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。

happen.en: He told me that whatever might happen, he was prepared for it.
happen.zh: 他告诉我不论发生什么，他都准备好了。

hammer.en: To the man who only has a hammer in the toolkit, every problem looks like a nail.
hammer.zh: 对工具箱里只有一把榔头的人来说，所有的问题都像钉子。

gun.en: Tom said that he keeps a gun in his home.
gun.zh: 汤姆说他的家里有把枪。

scar.en: I'll still have a scar from that accident.
scar.zh: 我还留着那起事故的伤疤。

brave.en: His brave deed earned him respect.
brave.zh: 他的英勇行为使他赢得了尊重。

rule.en: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.
rule.zh: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。

visitor.en: She's a frequent visitor to this country.

might.en: Tom said he thought he might be the only one who had to do that.
might.zh: 汤姆说他以为需要做那件事的就只有他一个。

haircut.en: I want to get a haircut before I go on the trip.
haircut.zh: 我想在出发旅行前剪个头发。

favor.en: I want you guys to do me a favor.
favor.zh: 我想要大家伙帮我个忙。

turning.en: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
turning.zh: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。

breath.en: After running up the hill, I was completely out of breath.
breath.zh: 跑上山后，我完全喘不过气来。

lion.en: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
lion.zh: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

whale.en: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
whale.zh: 一条受伤的鲸鱼在海滩边搁浅了。

mammal.en: A dolphin is a kind of mammal.

luck.en: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
luck.zh: 一点点的运气有时会导致意想不到的成功。

sign.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
sign.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

temple.en: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
temple.zh: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？

church.en: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
church.zh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。

cough.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
cough.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

diary.en: She has kept a diary for 3 years.
diary.zh: 她已经写了三年的日记。

recognize.en: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.
recognize.zh: 你变了那么多，以至于我几乎认不出你了。

share.en: For the time being, I must share this room with my friend.
share.zh: 眼下我不得不和我朋友同住这间房间。

drop.en: Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
drop.zh: 别忘了一到伦敦就给我们留言啊。

nonsense.en: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
nonsense.zh: 那是无稽之谈。只有傻瓜才会相信。

freedom.en: Freedom is the center of American democracy.
freedom.zh: 美国民主的中心思想是自由。

cigarette.en: He stopped for a quick cigarette.

insane.en: He behaves as if he were insane.

illness.en: We take health for granted until illness intervenes.
illness.zh: 我们视健康为理所当然, 直到疾病侵袭。

army.en: I had been in the army for a month when the war ended.
army.zh: 战争结束的时候，我已经在军队里待了一个月。

lady.en: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
lady.zh: 我们移走了行李腾出空间让老太太可以坐下。

writer.en: Every great writer seems to have been interested in English.
writer.zh: 每一个伟大的作家似乎已经对英语感兴趣。

handsome.en: Tom wasn't as handsome as Mary said he was.
handsome.zh: 汤姆并不是玛丽说得那样英俊。

promise.en: He is a man of few words, but he always keeps his promise.
promise.zh: 他这个人话不多，但总是遵守诺言。

suspicious.en: This statement is actually kind of suspicious.
suspicious.zh: 这种说法其实有点可疑。

bench.en: Tom and I sat on a bench in the park and talked while we fed pigeons.
bench.zh: 我和汤姆在公园的长椅上坐着，一边聊天一边喂着鸽子。

captain.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
captain.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。

genius.en: He thought that he was a genius.

speech.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
speech.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

reach.en: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
reach.zh: 在美国，大多数人能在十八岁以后投票。

save.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
save.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。

disagree.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
disagree.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

pattern.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
pattern.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

chicken.en: The child has a case of chicken pox.

unlucky.en: Four is an unlucky number in Japan.

sofa.en: This sofa can seat three people easily.
sofa.zh: 这张沙发起码可以坐三个人。

dumb.en: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and dumb.
dumb.zh: 海伦凯勒眼盲，耳聋，又哑。

relax.en: Tom wanted to stay home and relax instead of hiking with his children.
relax.zh: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。

silent.en: Since he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.
silent.zh: 自从他不知道该说什么的时候，便一直沉默着。

avoid.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
avoid.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。

rather.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
rather.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

assistant.en: I worked three years as Tom's assistant.
assistant.zh: 我给汤姆当了三年助手。

social.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
social.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

stranger.en: I'm a stranger here myself. I'm afraid I can't help you.
stranger.zh: 我对这里不熟。恐怕我不能帮你。

dying.en: Let's eat now. I'm dying of hunger.

married.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
married.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。

extremely.en: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
extremely.zh: 变量的声明在C和C++中极其重要。

roof.en: When Dad finds out what you've done, he's going to hit the roof.
roof.zh: 当爸爸发现你做了什么的时候，他会发疯的。

drawing.en: She succeeded in drawing the truth from him.
drawing.zh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。

proud.en: He is proud of having been educated in the United States.
proud.zh: 他对自己在美国读过书这件事感到很骄傲。

prison.en: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
prison.zh: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

wallet.en: My father took out his wallet and gave me ten dollars.
wallet.zh: 我爸爸拿出他的钱包，并给了我10美元。

dangerous.en: Tom wants to learn boxing, but his mother thinks it's too dangerous.
dangerous.zh: 汤姆想学拳击，但他妈妈觉得这太危险了。

bargain.en: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
bargain.zh: 这场减价活动会持续三天，从今天开始。

style.en: Pizza is the kind of food that fits into today's life style.
style.zh: 比萨是种适合现在的生活方式的食物。

safe.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
safe.zh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。

baseball.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
baseball.zh: 他喜欢看电视上的棒球比赛。

lift.en: She tried to lift the box, but found it impossible to do.
lift.zh: 她试了试举起箱子，但举不起来。

oxygen.en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
oxygen.zh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。

alcohol.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
alcohol.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。

mercury.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
mercury.zh: 水星是我们的太阳系中最小的行星。

pink.en: Who is the woman dressed in pink?
pink.zh: 那个穿粉红色衣服的女人是谁？

notebook.en: Tom wrote down something in his notebook.
notebook.zh: 汤姆在他的笔记本上写了东西。

purse.en: It was not until I reached home that I missed my purse.
purse.zh: 那是在我到家以后，我才不见了我的钱包。

throat.en: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
throat.zh: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。

whole.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
whole.zh: 我们有不到五分钟来疏散整栋楼的人。

roll.en: He was absent at roll call.

sleeve.en: The men are wearing short sleeve shirts.

finally.en: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
finally.zh: 经过长久的争论，我终于说服了她去露营。

mere.en: You're no longer a mere child.
mere.zh: 你不再只是一个孩子了。

line.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
line.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

disaster.en: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
disaster.zh: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。

poem.en: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
poem.zh: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。

exception.en: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
exception.zh: 这个月一直都很热，但今天是个例外。

button.en: All you have to do is push this button to take a picture.
button.zh: 你要做的就是按这个按钮拍照。

file.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
file.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

alarm.en: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
alarm.zh: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。

team.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
team.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

grateful.en: I'd be grateful to you if you could teach me to do that.
grateful.zh: 如果你能教我怎么做，我会很感激。

favorite.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
favorite.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

property.en: He passed his property on to his son.
property.zh: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。

eagle.en: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
eagle.zh: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

tie.en: Tom was wearing a yellow shirt with a blue tie.
tie.zh: 汤姆穿著一件黄色衬衫，系著一条蓝色领带。

shed.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
shed.zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。

kid.en: I can't believe that you were the smartest kid in your class.
kid.zh: 我不敢相信你是你们班里面最聪明的孩子。

decent.en: Tom is a decent sort of guy.

politician.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
politician.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。

agent.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
agent.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

fan.en: Does any other country fan the flames of patriotism as much as America?
fan.zh: 有没有一个国家比美国更提倡爱国主义？

awfully.en: I was awfully confused by his question.
awfully.zh: 我对他的问题感到非常困惑。

sandwich.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.
sandwich.zh: 我认为你该吃火腿三明治。

approval.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
approval.zh: 如果您同意, 我想给他这份工作。

shower.en: I was caught in a shower and got drenched to the skin.
shower.zh: 我遇上了阵雨被淋得全身湿透。

list.en: She went over the list to see if her name was there.
list.zh: 她走过去看看她的名字是否在清单上。

chess.en: We often played chess after school.
chess.zh: 我们常常在放学后下棋。

club.en: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
club.zh: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个俱乐部的成员。

writing.en: He devoted the last years of his life to writing his autobiography.

honey.en: How much honey do you want me to put in your tea?
honey.zh: 你想让我在你的茶里放多少蜂蜜？

occur.en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
occur.zh: 下雨天容易发生交通事故。

stuff.en: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
stuff.zh: 你不能把你的东西搬去另一个房间吗？

pie.en: Can I have a piece of this apple pie?
pie.zh: 我可以吃一块苹果派吗？

duty.en: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
duty.zh: 暴动开始时只有一位监狱长值班。

rely.en: People rely too much on phones these days.

anywhere.en: Did you go anywhere during the summer vacation?
anywhere.zh: 这个暑假你有去哪儿玩吗?

vacation.en: Tom intends to play tennis every day during his summer vacation.
vacation.zh: 汤姆打算暑假每天打网球。

protection.en: He did not think he needed their protection.
protection.zh: 他认为他不需要他们的保护。

prisoner.en: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
prisoner.zh: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

generous.en: I don't think that Tom was as generous as he should've been.

memory.en: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.

permit.en: Will you permit me to go there?

following.en: The girl was always following her mother.
following.zh: 那女孩不管到哪儿都跟著母亲。

blood.en: A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
blood.zh: 科学上，血型和性格的关联性没有被证明。

towel.en: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
towel.zh: 这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。

garage.en: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
garage.zh: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。

shopping.en: Tom almost always uses a credit card when he goes shopping.
shopping.zh: 汤姆在去购物的时候，几乎每次都会用信用卡。

careless.en: Tom told me he'd been careless.
careless.zh: 汤姆告诉我他一直很粗心。

childish.en: His way of thinking is very childish.

disappoint.en: Tom didn't want to disappoint Mary.

pig.en: A hungry pig dreams of acorns.

tense.en: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.
tense.zh: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。

cheese.en: My mother made us cheese sandwiches for lunch.
cheese.zh: 妈妈为我们做了乳酪三明治当午餐。

guide.en: Tom has a guide dog named Cookie.
guide.zh: 汤姆有一只导盲犬，名叫曲奇。

rescue.en: I'm going to help you rescue Tom.

income.en: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
income.zh: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出国旅行。

eyesight.en: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
eyesight.zh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。

energy.en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
energy.zh: 问题是, 太阳能太贵了。

sensitive.en: Cats' eyes are very sensitive to light.

used.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
used.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

kiss.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll give you a kiss.
kiss.zh: 如果你买给我冰淇淋，我就亲你一下。

honest.en: To be very honest with you, I don't think I can do that.
honest.zh: 和你说句实话，我觉得我做不到。

mayor.en: "What do you think of the election for mayor?" "I don't know."
mayor.zh: “你对市长选举怎么看？”“我不知道。”

player.en: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.
player.zh: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

bound.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.

hole.en: Manholes are round because that way they won't accidentally fall through the hole.
hole.zh: 人孔是圆的，因为这样人孔盖就不会意外地掉进洞里。

gain.en: They tried very hard to gain an advantage over one another.
gain.zh: 他们很努力地超过对方获得优势。

courage.en: I couldn't help but be impressed by Tom's courage.
courage.zh: 汤姆的勇气给我留下了深刻印象。

admire.en: Visitors to Switzerland admire the Alps.
admire.zh: 游客到瑞士欣赏阿尔卑斯山。

visa.en: We were disappointed to hear that Tom couldn't get a visa.
visa.zh: 我们很遗憾地听说，汤姆没能拿到签证。

lamp.en: He hung a lamp from the ceiling.
lamp.zh: 他把一盏灯挂在了天花板上。

barely.en: Tom can barely afford to pay rent let alone buy a PC.
barely.zh: 汤姆连房租都快付不起，更别说买一台电脑了。

forever.en: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
forever.zh: 要都解释的话，需要一辈子的时间。

envy.en: I envy the friendship Tom and Mary have.

intend.en: I intend to visit Australia during my spring break.
intend.zh: 我打算在春假的时候去参观澳洲。

course.en: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
course.zh: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。

couch.en: A couch potato is something that I don't want to be.
couch.zh: 我不想成为整天泡在沙发上看电视的人。

rent.en: Tom can barely afford to pay rent let alone buy a PC.
rent.zh: 汤姆连房租都快付不起，更别说买一台电脑了。

navy.en: Mary was wearing a navy blue skirt.
navy.zh: 玛丽穿着深蓝色的裙子。

prove.en: I just wanted to prove to myself that I could do this.
prove.zh: 我只想向自己证明我可以做到。

learning.en: I know that you are learning French at school.
learning.zh: 我知道你在学校学法语。

beginner.en: Tom's a beginner, but he catches on fast.
beginner.zh: 汤姆是个初学者，但他赶上得很快。

willing.en: Tom doesn't have any friends who are willing to help him.
willing.zh: 汤姆没有愿意帮助他的朋友。

police.en: The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
police.zh: 警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

prize.en: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.
prize.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖后，她仍谦虚如昔。

regular.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
regular.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

victory.en: They congratulated us on our victory.

voice.en: Tom always speaks in such a low voice that I can barely understand what he says.
voice.zh: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。

violin.en: You should practice playing the violin every day.
violin.zh: 你应该每天练习拉小提琴。

succeed.en: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
succeed.zh: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。

mission.en: Who picked you for this mission?

spy.en: One of them is a spy.

perhaps.en: I do not remember seeing the letter, but perhaps I read it.
perhaps.zh: 我不记得我看过这封信, 但或许我读过它。

weapon.en: Patience is sometimes the most effective weapon.
weapon.zh: 耐心有时候是最有效的武器。

beauty.en: Switzerland is famous for its scenic beauty.
beauty.zh: 瑞士以它的风景优美而闻名。

hug.en: Do you still want to give me a hug?

sweater.en: Take a sweater with you so you don't catch a cold.
sweater.zh: 为了不感冒，请带上这件毛衣。

cash.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
cash.zh: 汤姆把装满现金的信封递给玛丽。

obvious.en: It's obvious why his stomach hurts.
obvious.zh: 他为什么会胃痛的原因很明显。

couple.en: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
couple.zh: 一些航班由于地震被延误了。

soap.en: They wash their hands with soap.

salt.en: She discovered that she had run out of salt.

complain.en: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.
complain.zh: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。

act.en: You are old enough to know better than to act like that.
act.zh: 你够大了知道不要那样做。

rotten.en: The oranges in this bag are rotten.
rotten.zh: 这个袋子里的柳橙都烂了。

novel.en: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.
novel.zh: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。

rug.zh: 这块地毯是手工制作的。

burst.en: The water pipes froze and then burst.

guilty.en: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
guilty.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

absent.en: Nobody noticed that she was absent until the end of the meeting.
absent.zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

indispensable.zh: 水是生命所不可缺少的。

usual.en: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
usual.zh: 今天午餐时间，我们常去的饭馆关门了，因为他们家在办丧事。

treatment.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
treatment.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

shy.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.
shy.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。

architect.en: A famous architect built this house.
architect.zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。

imagination.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
imagination.zh: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

consider.en: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
consider.zh: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。

require.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
require.zh: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

carpet.en: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
carpet.zh: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。

event.en: On the whole, the event was successful.
event.zh: 整体而言，这个事件是成功的。

color.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
color.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

collect.en: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.

contain.en: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
contain.zh: 自来水有可能含有氯、铅等有害物质。

drawer.en: Tom took a spatula out of the drawer.
drawer.zh: 汤姆从抽屉里拿出一把锅铲。

daily.en: Most people write about their daily life.
daily.zh: 大部分人写的东西是关于他们的日常生活的。

fee.en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
fee.zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

bathroom.en: I sometimes hear my father singing in the bathroom.
bathroom.zh: 我有时会听到父亲在浴室里唱歌。

edge.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
edge.zh: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。

soda.en: Do you want a glass of soda?

guitar.en: When I came home, my sister was playing the guitar.
guitar.zh: 当我回到家的时候，我妹妹正在弹吉他。

coward.en: She resented being called a coward.
coward.zh: 她对被称为懦夫很反感。

adult.en: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
adult.zh: 请给我两张到伦敦的成人票，三张儿童票。

overestimate.en: We cannot overestimate the value of health.
overestimate.zh: 我们不能高估健康的价值。

apologize.en: You should apologize to Dad for not coming home in time for supper.
apologize.zh: 你应该为你没有及时回家吃晚餐向你父亲道歉。

leader.en: The leader governed his country for more than 50 years.
leader.zh: 这位领导人统治了他的国家五十年。

actually.en: You didn't actually want to go to Australia, did you?
actually.zh: 你其实不想去澳大利亚吧？

musician.en: In her opinion, he is the best musician she has ever seen.
musician.zh: 她认为他是她所见过最好的音乐家。

climb.en: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
climb.zh: 我认为在有风暴的时候里登山很危险。

propose.en: I'm going to propose to her.

ski.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.

transfer.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
transfer.zh: 我们会用银行转帐付款。

journal.en: My dad keeps a journal every day.

point.en: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
point.zh: 现在我们什么也做不了，救不了汤姆。我们唯一能做的就是祈祷。

mud.en: He scraped the mud off his boots.

step.en: Step out of the car and place your hands behind your back.

patience.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
patience.zh: 学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。

belt.en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
belt.zh: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。

fortune.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
fortune.zh: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

location.en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
location.zh: 那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

guilt.en: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
guilt.zh: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。

sharp.en: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
sharp.zh: 他的观察是敏锐的，但他没有说太多。

tongue.en: His name was on the tip of my tongue, but I couldn't remember it.
tongue.zh: 我都快要说出他的名字了，可就是记不起来。

wheel.en: Tom fell asleep at the wheel.
wheel.zh: 汤姆趴在方向盘上睡著了。

common.en: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
common.zh: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。

sense.en: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
sense.zh: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。

actress.en: It's said that she's a well-known actress.
actress.zh: 我听说她是个有名的演员。

sixty.en: My father will retire at the age of sixty.
sixty.zh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。

funny.en: He told us such a funny story that we all laughed.
funny.zh: 他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事，我们都笑了起来。

africa.en: Hemingway enjoyed big game hunting in Africa.
africa.zh: 海明威喜欢在非洲的大狩猎。

ability.en: I'm not satisfied with my English ability.
ability.zh: 我不满意我的英语能力。

concert.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
concert.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

dare.en: Tom wouldn't dare show his face around here again.
dare.zh: 汤姆不敢再到这里露面。

interview.en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
interview.zh: 在面试的时候你必须见机行事。

dove.en: There's a white dove on the roof.

lonely.en: When I first came back to Boston, I was really lonely.
lonely.zh: 当我第一次回波士顿时，我真是孤独。

attitude.en: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
attitude.zh: 抱著失败主义的态度你无法打一场漂亮的仗。

inspiration.en: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
inspiration.zh: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。

debt.en: All you have to do is ask him to pay the debt.
debt.zh: 你只需要喊他还债就行。

pillow.en: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
pillow.zh: 给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？

biology.en: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
biology.zh: 他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。

prefer.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
prefer.zh: 一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。

race.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
race.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

elderly.en: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
elderly.zh: 我们移走了行李腾出空间让老太太可以坐下。

respect.en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
respect.zh: 尊重法律是我们社会的基础。

shave.en: I've got to shave before leaving.

document.en: This document was actually written by Tom.
document.zh: 这文件其实是汤姆写的。

cream.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll give you a kiss.
cream.zh: 如果你买给我冰淇淋，我就亲你一下。

lawyer.en: He is reputed the best lawyer in this city.
lawyer.zh: 他被认为是这座城市里最好的律师。

participate.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.

wonder.en: I wonder if Tom really wanted to go to Australia with Mary.
wonder.zh: 我怀疑汤姆是不是真的想和玛丽一起去澳大利亚。

grandfather.en: My grandfather is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.
grandfather.zh: 我的爷爷喜欢大清早的散步。

absolutely.en: I think I understood everything Tom said, but I'm not absolutely sure.
absolutely.zh: 我认为我听懂了汤姆说的所有话，但我不确定。

ashamed.en: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
ashamed.zh: 我对自己的作为很内疚。

highly.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
highly.zh: 我知道不太可能有人愿意帮助我。

wedding.en: They wanted a wedding picture in front of the Eiffel Tower.
wedding.zh: 他们想在艾菲尔铁塔前面拍张结婚照。

terrible.en: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
terrible.zh: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

definitely.en: Tom says that Mary definitely won't accept the job.
definitely.zh: 汤姆说玛丽绝不会接受这工作。

fresh.en: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
fresh.zh: 新鲜水果和蔬菜有益健康。

beach.en: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.
beach.zh: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。

fool.en: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
fool.zh: 那是无稽之谈。只有傻瓜才会相信。

underwear.en: I am not wearing any underwear.

allow.en: The circumstances did not allow me to go abroad.

fashion.en: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
fashion.zh: 你可能认为那些鞋子很时髦, 但是他们不是。

resign.en: You should do the honorable thing and resign.

seventeen.en: A boy of seventeen is often as tall as his father.
seventeen.zh: 十七岁的男孩常常长得和他父亲一样高。

pop.en: I'd like to listen to pop music.

stubborn.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
stubborn.zh: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。

depression.en: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
depression.zh: 汤姆失业后，为了排遣郁闷的心情而开始了赌博。

consent.en: We will only consent on that condition.
consent.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

silence.en: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.
silence.zh: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。

wherever.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
wherever.zh: 汤姆无论到哪里都带着照相机。

intent.en: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
intent.zh: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。

engine.en: Keep the engine running. I'll be right back.
engine.zh: 让引擎持续运转，我去去就来。

evidence.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
evidence.zh: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。

false.en: The truth is that nothing is totally true or false.
false.zh: 真相是没有甚么完全正确或错误。

vote.en: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
vote.zh: 在美国，大多数人能在十八岁以后投票。

huge.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.
huge.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。

sentence.en: Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?
sentence.zh: 您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？

trousers.en: I bought two pairs of trousers.

minister.en: He made his way to the minister.

heat.en: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
heat.zh: 人会因为体温而在红外线摄影机上显现。

reservation.zh: 汤姆把酒店订单取消了。

coach.en: I knew Tom would be a good basketball coach. That's why I hired him.
coach.zh: 我知道汤姆会成为一位优秀的篮球教练。这就是为什么我聘用了他。

ribbon.en: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
ribbon.zh: 那女孩的头发上绑了一根黄丝带。

jeans.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.
jeans.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。

horror.en: I'm going to see a horror film.

apology.zh: 汤姆不接受玛丽的道歉。

schedule.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
schedule.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

situation.en: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
situation.zh: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

horrible.en: I just wish we could leave this horrible place.
horrible.zh: 我只是希望我们能离开这个可怕的地方。

goal.en: He never gave up hope that he would reach that goal.
goal.zh: 他从没放弃达成那个目标的希望。

elevator.en: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
elevator.zh: 我到柜台拿了钥匙，然后就乘电梯去了我房间的楼层。

radium.en: It was Marie Curie who discovered radium.
radium.zh: 镭是居里夫人所发现的。

hire.en: If he's fluent in English, I'll hire him.
hire.zh: 如果他说得一口流利的英文，我就请他为我工作。

tour.en: How much is the tour per person?

protect.en: We should tell children how to protect themselves.
protect.zh: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。

reap.en: As you sow, so shall you reap.

sow.en: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

account.en: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
account.zh: 一些航班由于地震被延误了。

fox.en: The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy brown dog.
fox.zh: 身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的棕狗。

wild.en: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
wild.zh: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

rock.en: Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
rock.zh: 你比较喜欢哪一个，摇滚乐还是古典音乐？

private.en: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
private.zh: 她雇了一个私人侦探看守她的丈夫。

organ.en: Do you know how to play the organ?

whenever.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
whenever.zh: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。

ink.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
ink.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

law.en: Everybody is supposed to know the law, but few people really do.
law.zh: 每一个人都应该知法懂法，但是真正能做到的人却很少。

relative.en: Tom is a distant relative of mine.

fancy.en: Tom and Mary stayed at a fancy hotel.
fancy.zh: 汤姆和玛丽入住了一家高档酒店。

candle.en: When the lights went out, Tom lit a candle.
candle.zh: 灯灭了，汤姆点起了蜡烛。

lung.en: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
lung.zh: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。

cancer.en: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
cancer.zh: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。

salary.en: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
salary.zh: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。

appetite.en: A little walk will give you a good appetite for breakfast.
appetite.zh: 散散步将会给你很好的食欲吃早餐。

fluent.en: I consider myself fairly fluent in French.
fluent.zh: 我认为自己的法语相当流利。

mood.en: I hope Tom is in a good mood tomorrow.
mood.zh: 我希望汤姆明天心情愉快。

deaf.en: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
deaf.zh: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。

probably.en: Tom probably knows where we can get something to eat around here.
probably.zh: 汤姆应该知道这附近哪里有东西吃。

dentist.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
dentist.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

wealth.en: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
wealth.zh: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个俱乐部的成员。

history.en: If you want to know a country, you must learn its history.
history.zh: 如果想了解一个国家，就必须学习这个国家的历史。

explain.en: Tom doesn't quite get it. Could you explain it to him again?
explain.zh: 汤姆不大明白。你能再跟他解释一遍吗？

figure.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
figure.zh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

stare.en: It isn't polite to stare at people.

wonderful.en: The show was wonderful, but the tickets were too expensive.
wonderful.zh: 这场秀棒极了，但是门票太贵了。

attack.en: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
attack.zh: 敌人对那栋建筑物使出了强力攻击。

fountain.en: How much does this fountain pen cost?

sack.en: It's time to hit the sack.

clothing.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
clothing.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

suppose.en: Suppose you had a thousand dollars, what would you do with it?
suppose.zh: 假如你有1000美元，你会用它做什么呢？

jealous.en: You must not be jealous of others' success.
jealous.zh: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。

quart.en: I want a quart of milk.

weigh.zh: 请你称一下这个的重量好吗？

rare.en: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
rare.zh: 你所要做的便是好好把握这千载难逢的机会。

vision.en: My vision is getting worse these days.
vision.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。

anxious.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
anxious.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

assist.en: I'll be able to assist you.

faith.en: I have absolute faith in you.

metal.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
metal.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

useful.en: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
useful.zh: 只有能提出新问题的回答才是有用的回答。

iron.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
iron.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

recent.en: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
recent.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

available.en: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
available.zh: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。

intention.en: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
intention.zh: Tom没有意图去邀请Mary去即将来临的舞会。

fairly.en: Tom seems to be a fairly successful businessman.
fairly.zh: 汤姆看来是个很成功的商人。

noisy.en: Japan is an extremely noisy country.
noisy.zh: 日本是一个非常嘈杂的国家。

cross.en: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
cross.zh: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。

picnic.en: I can still remember the time when we went on a picnic together.
picnic.zh: 我还记得我和你一起去野餐的时候。

fair.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
fair.zh: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。

introduce.en: I think the time is right to introduce this product.
introduce.zh: 我觉得现在是发表这个产品的好时机。

quit.en: Tom told Mary that she should quit pretending to be intoxicated.
quit.zh: 汤姆告诉玛丽她应该停止假装醉酒。

deny.en: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.
deny.zh: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。

add.en: Is there anything you want to add to what I just said?
add.zh: 我刚才说的内容，你想补充么？

spell.en: How do you spell your family name?

rainy.en: It was during the rainy season three years ago that Tom first met Mary.
rainy.zh: 三年前的雨季，汤姆第一次遇见了玛丽。

singer.en: I know Tom is a good singer, but I think Mary is better.
singer.zh: 我知道汤姆唱歌很好听，但我认为玛丽唱得更好。

switch.en: Switch on the light. I can't see anything.
switch.zh: 把灯打开。我什么都看不见了。

correct.en: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
correct.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。

whatever.en: He told me that whatever might happen, he was prepared for it.
whatever.zh: 他告诉我不论发生什么，他都准备好了。

comment.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
comment.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

means.en: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
means.zh: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

spread.en: English has spread all over the country.

unfair.en: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
unfair.zh: 你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。

relevant.en: I thought his opinion was relevant.
relevant.zh: 我认为他的意见很中肯。

unlikely.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
unlikely.zh: 我知道不太可能有人愿意帮助我。

final.en: We left the final decision to him.
final.zh: 我们让他做最后的决定。

concern.zh: 你的问题和我没有关系。

sole.en: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
sole.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

mouse.en: Should I buy a wireless mouse?
mouse.zh: 要不要买个无线鼠标呢？

melt.en: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.
melt.zh: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。

knee.en: I played with the baby on my knee.

vase.en: You need to put more water in the vase.
vase.zh: 你需要往花瓶里加更多的水。

rocket.en: The rocket was launched into space.

blind.en: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
blind.zh: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。

wooden.en: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
wooden.zh: 花园被木栅栏围了起来。

soil.en: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
soil.zh: 这起空难是迄今为止加拿大境内最严重的空难。

rose.en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.
rose.zh: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。

garlic.en: The food tasted slightly of garlic.
garlic.zh: 这个食物尝起来有一点大蒜味。

accident.en: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.
accident.zh: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。

twin.en: He mistook me for my twin brother.
twin.zh: 他把我误认为我的双胞胎兄弟。

native.en: This book is for students whose native language is not Japanese.
native.zh: 这本书是给母语不是日语的学生的。

sigh.en: She gave out a sigh of relief.

sight.en: The baby caught sight of my ballpoint pen and reached out for it.
sight.zh: 这个婴儿盯著我的原子笔看, 并且伸手要拿它。

bloom.en: This week the cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.

downstairs.en: Someone is waiting for you downstairs.

fog.en: London, where I live, used to be famous for its fog.
fog.zh: 我住的地方－伦敦，从前以雾闻名。

electricity.en: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
electricity.zh: 澳大利亚在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。

dawn.en: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
dawn.zh: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。

apartment.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
apartment.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。

stock.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
stock.zh: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

disease.en: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
disease.zh: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。

turkey.en: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
turkey.zh: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

hall.en: Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?
hall.zh: 你知道从火车站到市政府有多远？

peach.en: Tom isn't eating a peach. He's eating a plum.
peach.zh: 汤姆没有吃桃子，他在吃李子。

jail.en: Tom spent more than three years in jail.
jail.zh: 汤姆蹲了三年多的监狱。

express.en: I'd like to know the phone number of the nearest American Express office.
express.zh: 我想知道最近的美国运通办事处的电话号码。

monkey.en: I'm not talking to you. I'm talking to the monkey.
monkey.zh: 我不是在跟你说话，我在跟猴子说话。

wise.en: A wise leader knows when to listen to others.
wise.zh: 聪明的领袖知道什么时候要听取他人意见。

ought.en: Don't you think you ought to write them a thank-you note?
ought.zh: 你不觉得你应该给他们写一封感谢信吗？

tractor.en: I can't get my tractor started.
tractor.zh: 我发动不了我的拖拉机。

raw.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
raw.zh: 日本从国外进口各种原料。

lower.en: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
lower.zh: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。

chocolate.en: Does that chocolate bar have nuts in it?
chocolate.zh: 那块巧克力里面有坚果吗？

bowl.en: The dog is sitting by the bowl.

indian.en: Taiwanese food is milder than Indian food.
indian.zh: 台湾菜比印度菜口味淡。

belong.en: Iceland used to belong to Denmark.

dozen.en: Several dozen young people participated in the demonstration.
dozen.zh: 几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。

pleasant.en: She had a pleasant dream last night.

journey.en: Reading a book can be compared to a journey.
journey.zh: 阅读一本书可以比作一次旅行。

physics.en: He had a book on physics published.
physics.zh: 他有一本关于物理学的书被出版了。

toy.en: It was her little sister that broke her toy.
toy.zh: 她的玩具是被她妹妹弄坏的。

composer.zh: 他是一位著名的作曲家。

eager.en: When we are told not to come, we become all the more eager to go.
eager.zh: 让我们别来，我们就更想来了。

chemistry.en: I majored in chemistry at the university.

stewardess.en: A stewardess was rescued from the wreck.
stewardess.zh: 一名空姐从飞机残骸中被救出来了。

intelligent.en: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
intelligent.zh: 他不像他的兄长那样聪明。

tidy.en: The cottage was clean and tidy.

runner.en: The runner jumped over the hole in the ground.
runner.zh: 那个赛跑运动员跃过了地面上的洞。

appreciate.en: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.

tremble.zh: 我感觉到我的手在震动

childhood.en: When I heard that song, it reminded me of my childhood.
childhood.zh: 我一听到那首歌，就想起来我小的时候。

sweep.en: You have to sweep the floor.

artist.en: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
artist.zh: 给这本书画插画的画家很好。

jelly.zh: 葡萄味的果冻是我最喜欢的。

grape.en: That isn't wine. It's grape juice.
grape.zh: 这不是葡萄酒，是葡萄汁。

volleyball.en: Some people like volleyball, others enjoy tennis.
volleyball.zh: 有些人喜欢排球，其他人喜欢网球。

strongly.en: I'm strongly opposed to a compromise.

recommend.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
recommend.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。

candy.en: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
candy.zh: 我不论甚么时候都不该让汤姆吃那么多糖。

rid.en: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
rid.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

attend.en: "Why are you going to Japan?" "To attend a conference in Tokyo."
attend.zh: “你去日本干嘛？”“去东京参加一个会议。”

content.en: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
content.zh: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

rude.en: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
rude.zh: 他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。

boss.en: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
boss.zh: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。

living.en: I think that our living together has influenced your habits.
living.zh: 我觉得我和你一起住影响了你生活的方式。

occasionally.en: The mother occasionally reread her son's letter.
occasionally.zh: 这位母亲偶尔会重温她的儿子的信件。

unfortunately.en: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.
unfortunately.zh: 不幸的是，我必须每天早起。

uncomfortable.en: I felt cold and uncomfortable the entire night.
uncomfortable.zh: 我整个晚上觉得又冷又不舒服。

stone.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

oil.en: Japan depends on foreign countries for oil.

attractive.en: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
attractive.zh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

plenty.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.
plenty.zh: 医生坚持病人获得充分的休息。

eighty.en: Eighty percent of all information on computers around the world is in English.
eighty.zh: 全世界百分之八十电脑上的资讯都是用英语写的。

album.en: He showed me his photograph album.

whichever.en: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
whichever.zh: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。

original.en: Tom makes his own original Christmas cards every year.
original.zh: 汤姆每年都会制作自己独创的圣诞节贺卡。

butterfly.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.

castle.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
castle.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

contract.en: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
contract.zh: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

cloth.en: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
cloth.zh: 她买了六码的布做衣服。

jet.zh: 这架客机降落在东京了。

loud.en: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?
loud.zh: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？

eve.en: I'm spending Christmas Eve with my family.

sheet.en: Bring me a sheet of paper, please.

storm.en: Because of the storm, we had no choice but to stay at home.
storm.zh: 因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

sum.en: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
sum.zh: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。

entrance.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
entrance.zh: 我听说你通过了入学考试。恭喜你了！

ancient.en: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.

orphan.en: He became an orphan when he was ten.

skip.en: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
skip.zh: 偶尔不吃早餐也不会如何不好呀。

diamond.en: This might not be a genuine diamond.

textbook.en: Tom told me that he had lost his textbook.
textbook.zh: 汤姆告诉我他丢了课本。

vague.en: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
vague.zh: 她隐约地有一种的内疚感。

paragraph.zh: 这一个段落是模糊不清的。

program.en: If you do not have this program, you can download it now.
program.zh: 假如你没有这个程序，你现在就可以去下载。

shovel.en: Tom is going to shovel the snow off the roof for us.
shovel.zh: 汤姆正要为我们铲掉屋顶上的雪。

ignorant.en: I am quite ignorant of their plan.
ignorant.zh: 他们的计划我一无所知。

essay.en: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
essay.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。

cheek.en: Tom kissed Mary on the cheek.

curious.en: "What's going on in the cave? I'm curious." "I have no idea."
curious.zh: “洞里发生了什么？我很好奇。”“我一点也不知道。”

nap.en: Maybe I'll just give up soon and take a nap instead.
nap.zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

flame.en: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
flame.zh: 硫磺燃烧著蓝色的火焰。

audience.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
audience.zh: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。

therapy.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
therapy.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

type.en: I'm the type who gets nervous in front of people, so I'm bad at speech making.
type.zh: 我是那种面对人群很紧张的人，所以我的演讲能力很差。

stage.en: Are there any famous musicians on the stage?
stage.zh: 舞台上有著名音乐家吗？

courageous.en: Tom is very courageous, isn't he?

delete.en: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
delete.zh: 我希望我能知道如何删除我的Facebook帐号。

happiness.en: It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
happiness.zh: 不言自明，金钱买不到幸福。

depend.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
depend.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

advance.en: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
advance.zh: 地面高低不平，给部队前进带来了困难。

hopeless.en: By the way, my English is absolutely hopeless.
hopeless.zh: 顺道一提，我的英语是绝对没有希望了。

remind.en: Let me remind you again that March 31st is the due date.
remind.zh: 让我再次提醒你3月31日是到期日。

square.en: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.

pinch.en: Add a tiny pinch of salt.

tiny.en: He came from a tiny mountain town.

committee.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
committee.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

proceed.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
proceed.zh: 让我们继续进行议程上的项目。

pint.en: Beer is sold by the pint.

flour.en: Mix the flour with two eggs.
flour.zh: 把面粉和两颗鸡蛋混合。

wheat.en: Can you tell wheat from barley?
wheat.zh: 你能辨别小麦和大麦吗？

jacket.en: Put this jacket on, and you'll be much warmer.
jacket.zh: 穿上外套吧！你会暖一些。

clearly.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
clearly.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

coal.en: Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.
coal.zh: 澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。

interest.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
interest.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

article.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
article.zh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

sew.en: Did you sew this by hand?

cell.en: "Have you seen my cell phone?" "It's on the table."
cell.zh: "你有看到我的手机吗?" "它在桌子上。"

extra.en: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
extra.zh: 我太太兼职的工作赚进了一些额外的钱。

trap.en: We set a trap to catch a fox.
trap.zh: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。

pepper.en: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
pepper.zh: 我在鱼上洒盐和胡椒作调味。

marriage.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
marriage.zh: 婚前张开眼，婚后半闭眼。

rush.en: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
rush.zh: 天使畏惧处, 愚人敢闯入。

ruler.en: Draw a line with a ruler.

education.en: He always left the problem of his children's education to his wife.
education.zh: 他总是把孩子的教育问题留给他的妻子。

enthusiasm.zh: 汤姆没有感受到玛丽的热情。

thorn.en: I have a thorn in my finger.

lately.en: I've been coming to work one train earlier lately.
lately.zh: 我已经搭了最近比较早一点的火车来上班。

envelope.en: Tom told me not to open the envelope until my birthday.
envelope.zh: 汤姆告诉我，到我生日那天我才能打开信封。

humor.en: The main problem with Tom is that he has no sense of humor.
humor.zh: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

onto.en: If we'd arrived ten minutes earlier, we would've made it onto the plane.
onto.zh: 要是我们早十分钟到的话，我们就能赶上飞机了。

principal.en: Our school's principal is very old.

seldom.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
seldom.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

overcoat.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.
overcoat.zh: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。

bankrupt.en: The company's going to go bankrupt really soon.

president.en: Tom started as a janitor, but he's now the president of the company.
president.zh: 汤姆最初是看门人，但现在他是公司的总裁了。

character.en: Who's your favorite character in this book?
character.zh: 你最喜欢这本书中的哪个角色？

stadium.en: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
stadium.zh: 体育场内已搭建起舞台。

package.en: Did you get the package that I sent you?
package.zh: 你收到我寄给你的包裹了吗？

excellent.en: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
excellent.zh: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。

complete.en: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
complete.zh: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。

painting.en: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
painting.zh: 这幅画被估价数百万元。

sauce.en: His shirt was stained with sauce.
sauce.zh: 他的衬衫被酱汁弄脏了。

hunger.en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.

bet.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.

suitcase.en: Don't you want to see what I have in my suitcase?
suitcase.zh: 你不想看我的行李箱里有什么吗？

logic.en: Do you not understand basic logic?

certain.en: I'm certain that Tom is the only one who won't do that.
certain.zh: 我确信汤姆是唯一不会那么做的人。

harm.en: I don't wish to harm you.

kick.en: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
kick.zh: 她开朗的个性使我觉得快乐。

subway.en: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
subway.zh: 在伦敦，警察总是担心在列车或地铁上发现炸弹。

forest.en: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.
forest.zh: 她缓缓消失在雾气弥漫的森林中。

confidence.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
confidence.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

nowhere.en: Tom had nowhere to return to.

unusual.en: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
unusual.zh: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

cupboard.en: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.
cupboard.zh: 她把毛巾折叠好再放入柜子里。

prince.en: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
prince.zh: 威廉王子是英国王位第二顺位继承人

renew.en: I have to renew my passport.

provided.en: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
provided.zh: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

exciting.en: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?
exciting.zh: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？

enter.en: People who drink alcoholic beverages are not allowed to enter.

reserve.en: I'd like to reserve a room in a hotel.

scientist.en: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
scientist.zh: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。

university.en: The university was founded by his father twenty years ago.
university.zh: 大学在20年前由他的父亲建立。

pregnant.en: One out of 455 women doesn't realize she's pregnant until the twentieth week of pregnancy.
pregnant.zh: 455名妇女中会有一名直到怀孕第二十周前没有意识到自己怀孕。

speaker.en: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
speaker.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。

responsible.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
responsible.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。

pet.en: She keeps a parrot as a pet.
pet.zh: 她养一只鹦鹉作为宠物。

basic.en: Mathematics is basic to all sciences.
basic.zh: 数学是所有科学的基础。

pitch.en: This is a good place to pitch a tent.

mix.en: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.
mix.zh: 我不喜欢把生意和快乐混在一起。

pressure.en: I'm under so much pressure, I just want to cry.

stick.en: Tom wrote his name in the sand with a stick.
stick.zh: 汤姆用棍子在沙上写了他的名字。

fact.en: As a matter of fact, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
fact.zh: 事实上，我从今天早上开始没有吃任何东西。

blanket.en: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
blanket.zh: 给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？

peel.en: I'll peel an orange for you.

pride.en: It was difficult for him to hide his pride in his success.
pride.zh: 他很难掩饰对自己成功的骄傲。

percent.en: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
percent.zh: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

ladder.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
ladder.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？

cancel.en: I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.
cancel.zh: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。

inside.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
inside.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

difference.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
difference.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

pot.en: Put the carrots in the pot.

fuel.en: The fuel tank in the car is full.

nail.en: To the man who only has a hammer in the toolkit, every problem looks like a nail.
nail.zh: 对工具箱里只有一把榔头的人来说，所有的问题都像钉子。

refrigerator.en: There's a bottle of white wine in the refrigerator.
refrigerator.zh: 冰箱里有一瓶白葡萄酒。

solution.en: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
solution.zh: 必须有外交解决的途径。

request.en: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
request.zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。

goods.en: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
goods.zh: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。

amount.en: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
amount.zh: 已经花费了很多的时间和精力。

tax.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.
tax.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。

flag.en: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.
flag.zh: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。

reliable.en: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.
reliable.zh: 天气预报一点也不可靠。

logical.en: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
logical.zh: 最合逻辑的放鞋处是门口附近。

slice.en: Will you have another slice of pie?

innocent.en: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
innocent.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

veteran.zh: 汤姆是一个越军退役军人。

natural.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
natural.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。

athlete.zh: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。

teenager.en: I feel like I'm a teenager again.

unknown.en: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.

warning.en: I warned him, but he ignored the warning.
warning.zh: 我警告过他，但他不理会警告。

backward.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.
backward.zh: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。

apart.en: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
apart.zh: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。

pound.en: Fish is sold by the pound here.
pound.zh: 鱼在这里是以磅为单位来出售。

draft.en: I am writing a draft of the speech.

india.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
india.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

toward.en: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
toward.zh: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

feather.en: Down in the valley a mist like a white feather rose gently into a white cloud, and obscured everything.
feather.zh: 山谷中，薄雾如白色羽毛般缓缓升腾，化作一团白云，遮蔽了一切。

exactly.en: Tom didn't know exactly what it was that Mary wanted him to do.
exactly.zh: 汤姆不知道玛丽到底让他做什么。

hint.en: Would you give me a hint?
hint.zh: 你可以给我一个提示吗？

mixture.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.

equal.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.

anyway.en: We're all going to die anyway.
anyway.zh: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。

painful.en: There's nothing more painful than losing one's child.
painful.zh: 没有比失去孩子更伤心的事。

oven.en: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
oven.zh: 蛋糕应该差不多可以出炉了。

breathe.en: I want to breathe some fresh air.
breathe.zh: 我想呼吸一下新鲜空气。

boil.en: I'll boil the potatoes for you.

puzzle.en: Have you worked the puzzle out?

solve.en: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
solve.zh: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。

vacuum.en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
vacuum.zh: 我免费得到了这个吸尘器。

provide.en: He has a wife and two young children to provide for.
provide.zh: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子要养活。

divide.en: Let's divide this money between you and me.

deliver.en: Please deliver it to this address.
deliver.zh: 你能把它送到这个地址吗？

temperature.en: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.
temperature.zh: 小孩的体温一般比大人的要高。

pirate.en: Tom was dressed like a pirate.

cruel.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
cruel.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。

bush.en: A bird in the hand is better than two in the bush.
bush.zh: 一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。

hang.en: Give a thief enough rope and he'll hang himself.

crush.en: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.

promising.zh: 他是一位有前途的学生。

ordinary.en: I did nothing out of the ordinary.

unable.en: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
unable.zh: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。

stream.en: A stream of people came out of the theater.

poison.en: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
poison.zh: 矛尖浸在一种致命的毒药里。

dirt.en: The children were playing in the dirt.

admission.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
admission.zh: 五岁以下的小孩票价全免。

bend.en: I can't bend my right arm.
bend.zh: 我无法弯曲我的右手臂。

suspect.en: I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
suspect.zh: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。

swamp.en: I don't mean to swamp you.

german.en: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
german.zh: 不提英语，他还会说德语和法语。

sand.en: The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.
sand.zh: 老人在骡子的背上放上了一个个装满了沙的袋子。

difficulty.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.

remain.en: Please remain seated for a few minutes.

optimistic.en: I'm not as optimistic as you are.

cause.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

lightning.en: The taller the tree, the more likely it is to be struck by lightning.

dial.en: In the case of fire, dial 119.

dump.en: Is Tom going to dump Mary?

winner.en: It is good to be a winner.

artificial.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
artificial.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

convenient.en: I think you will find it convenient to put a short-cut on the desktop.
convenient.zh: 我想你迟早会知道在桌面建立一个快捷方式是有多方便。

funeral.en: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
funeral.zh: 今天午餐时间，我们常去的饭馆关门了，因为他们家在办丧事。

claim.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
claim.zh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

professor.en: The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
professor.zh: 那个教授讲得太快了，没有一个人听得懂。

gas.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
gas.zh: 这场爆炸有可能是瓦斯外泄引起的。

yard.en: Tom planted three apple trees in his yard.
yard.zh: 汤姆在他的院子里种了三棵苹果树。

accurate.en: This data isn't accurate at all.
accurate.zh: 这个数据一点也不准确。

plus.en: The sum of two plus three plus four is nine.

fence.en: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
fence.zh: 花园被木栅栏围了起来。

separately.en: Could you wrap this separately, please?

interrupt.en: I didn't mean to interrupt anything.

likely.en: The taller the tree, the more likely it is to be struck by lightning.

makeup.en: Tom doesn't like women who wear too much makeup.
makeup.zh: 汤姆不喜欢妆化太浓的女人。

entire.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
entire.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

needle.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
needle.zh: 我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。

suddenly.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
suddenly.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

track.en: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
track.zh: 我的生意终于走上了正轨。

pan.en: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
pan.zh: 我每天至少用一次煎锅。

unexpected.en: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
unexpected.zh: 一点点的运气有时会导致意想不到的成功。

rabbit.en: Rather than live a hundred years as a rabbit, live one day as a tiger.
rabbit.zh: 宁可当只老虎活一天，也不愿当只兔子过一百年。

economy.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
economy.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

king.en: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
king.zh: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

message.en: "Shall I take a message?" "No, thank you."
message.zh: “需要我为您留个口信儿吗？”“不用了，谢谢。”

pond.en: When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
pond.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。

stew.en: Tom added broccoli to the stew.
stew.zh: 汤姆往炖菜里加了西兰花。

hypothesis.zh: 这一结果证实了我的猜想。

whisky.en: How do you like this whisky?
whisky.zh: 你觉得这威士忌怎么样？

master.en: It's quite difficult to master French in 2 or 3 years.

mobile.en: I need to charge my mobile phone.

condition.en: We will only consent on that condition.
condition.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

beard.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
beard.zh: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

romantic.en: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.
romantic.zh: 他是个非常浪漫的男朋友，每晚都给我送花。

discussion.en: They came up with a plan after a long discussion.
discussion.zh: 他们终于在漫长的讨论之后得出了一个计划。

fiction.en: He's very fond of science fiction.

trim.en: Did you trim the apple trees?

immediately.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
immediately.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

prevail.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

waiter.en: He is a waiter in a seaside restaurant.
waiter.zh: 他是一家海滨餐厅的服务员。

furniture.en: A few years ago, our room had little furniture in it.
furniture.zh: 几年前，我们的房间里没有什么家具。

competent.en: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
competent.zh: 有人说你是个很有能力的人。

hike.zh: 我们应该取消这次远足。

exchange.en: The company went public and became listed on the stock exchange in 1990.

rate.en: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
rate.zh: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

central.en: Excuse me, but could you tell me how to get to Central Park?
central.zh: 不好意思，请问到中央公园要怎么走?

art.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
art.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

actor.en: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
actor.zh: 你想成为一名电影演员吗？

salad.en: Mary put some roasted pecans into her salad.
salad.zh: 玛莉在沙拉里放了一些烤山核桃。

aggressive.zh: 他是个咄咄逼人的的人。

bucket.en: Please fill this bucket with water.

scissors.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
