scissors.zh: 这把剪刀左右撇子都适用。

endure.en: Can she endure a long trip?

discount.en: Tom sells T-shirts at a 30 percent discount.

whistle.en: Do you know how to whistle?

overseas.en: I'd like to make an overseas call.

hook.en: Hang your coat on the hook.
hook.zh: 把你的外套挂在钩子上。

repair.en: I will only buy the car if they repair the brakes first.
repair.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。

privacy.en: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
privacy.zh: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。

expert.en: Even expert drivers can make mistakes.
expert.zh: 再怎么经验老到的司机都会出错。

top.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.
top.zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。

speed.en: There are several ways to measure speed.

uneasy.en: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.
uneasy.zh: 我知道你不自在，但别急。

drama.en: They made the novel into a drama.
drama.zh: 他们把这本小说变成戏剧。

scare.en: I didn't mean to scare Tom.

tempt.en: I didn't mean to tempt you.

sympathy.en: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
sympathy.zh: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

generally.en: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
generally.zh: 通常学生们喜欢理解他们问题的老师。

ginger.en: I hate the taste of ginger.

frog.en: Eat a live frog every morning, and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.
frog.zh: 每天早上吃一只活青蛙, 那么你一天中其他的时间就不会发生什么更糟糕的事了。

spanish.en: I wish I could have spoken Spanish.
spanish.zh: 要是我会说西班牙语就好了。

passion.en: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
passion.zh: 诗人对他爱的女人表达了他火热的激情。

scenery.en: Tom said the scenery was more beautiful than he thought it would be.
scenery.zh: 汤姆说，风景比他想像的还要美。

support.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.
support.zh: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。

reform.en: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
reform.zh: 他提议对教育系统进行改革。

political.en: It takes time to develop political awareness.
political.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。

seriously.en: They say you shouldn't take rumors seriously, but that's easier said than done.
seriously.zh: 人们常说不要乱相信谣言，但说起来容易做起来难。

mosquito.en: Minnesota's state bird is the mosquito.
mosquito.zh: 明尼苏达州的官方鸟就是蚊子。

customer.en: We're looking for someone who has experience in customer service.
customer.zh: 我们正在寻找具有客服工作经验的人。

tip.en: His name was on the tip of my tongue, but I couldn't remember it.
tip.zh: 我都快要说出他的名字了，可就是记不起来。

citizen.en: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
citizen.zh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

approve.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
approve.zh: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。

sleepy.en: I felt so sleepy that I could hardly keep my eyes open.
sleepy.zh: 我感觉困得几乎不能睁开我的眼睛了。

snake.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.
snake.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。

nearby.en: My wife buys vegetables from a supermarket nearby.
nearby.zh: 我老婆在附近的超市买蔬菜。

board.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
board.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

especially.en: I like to listen to music, especially jazz.
especially.zh: 我喜欢听音乐，特别是爵士音乐。

shock.en: She got over the shock of her father's death.
shock.zh: 她从她父亲过世的震惊中恢复了。

split.zh: 让我们平分这个报酬吧。

nowadays.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
nowadays.zh: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。

disposal.en: My car is at your disposal.

grandmother.en: My grandmother mailed the letter this morning.
grandmother.zh: 今天早上我祖母寄出了这封信。

poet.en: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
poet.zh: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。

action.en: Action speaks louder than words, but not nearly as often.
action.zh: 行胜于言，但并不是所有情况都是这样。

less.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
less.zh: 我们有不到五分钟来疏散整栋楼的人。

tender.en: My father was no less affectionate and tender to me than my mother was.
tender.zh: 我爸爸对我的爱和照顾不比我妈妈少。

fate.en: She had to accept her fate.

well-known.en: It's said that she's a well-known actress.
well-known.zh: 我听说她是个有名的演员。

expression.zh: 那种表达方式已经过时了。

responsibility.en: I take full responsibility for the action.
responsibility.zh: 我会为这次行动负起全责。

election.en: "What do you think of the election for mayor?" "I don't know."
election.zh: “你对市长选举怎么看？”“我不知道。”

exhibition.en: Did you go to the art exhibition?

reasonable.en: Tom bought this camera for a reasonable price.
reasonable.zh: Tom用合理的价格买了相机。

typical.en: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.
typical.zh: 我发现他就是会很晚才来这样的人。

directly.en: I got the information from him directly.
directly.zh: 我直接从他那里得到讯息。

urgent.en: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
urgent.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

latin.en: Many English words are derived from Latin.
latin.zh: 许多英文单字源自于拉丁文。

border.en: I was asked to show my passport at the border.
border.zh: 在边境上，我被要求出示我的护照。

flu.en: I was vaccinated against the flu.

attention.en: Don't pay any attention to what your father says.

react.en: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
react.zh: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。

essential.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
essential.zh: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。

gather.en: I gather that they'll agree with us.
gather.zh: 我猜想他们会同意我们的。

variety.en: We talked about a variety of topics.

shade.en: There's no light without shade, and no shade without light.
shade.zh: 不存在没有阴影的光明，也不存在没有光明的阴影。

execute.zh: 我们必须执行他的命令。

confident.en: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
confident.zh: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。

birth.en: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
birth.zh: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

volume.en: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.
volume.zh: 声音大声一点，以便让坐在后边的学生能听到。

judge.en: The prisoner was brought before a judge.
judge.zh: 这个囚犯被带到法官面前。

chairman.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
chairman.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。

average.en: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
average.zh: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。

timid.en: A mouse is a timid creature.

creature.en: Tom says that he's a creature of habit.
creature.zh: 汤姆说他是习惯的产物。

stitch.en: A stitch in time saves nine.
stitch.zh: 小洞及时补，免遭大洞苦。

elephant.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
elephant.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

bark.en: A dog will bark at strangers.

repeat.en: Could you please repeat what you just said?
repeat.zh: 您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？

racket.en: Where did you get this tennis racket?
racket.zh: 你从哪里弄来这把网球拍的？

wealthy.en: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.
wealthy.zh: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。

laundry.en: I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.

towards.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
towards.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。

soft.en: She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
soft.zh: 她是个又高又瘦, 留著一头又长又软的褐色头发的女孩。

robbery.en: He was in prison on a charge of robbery.

kite.en: There is a kite flying above the tree.

loan.en: I told Tom I'd be willing to loan him some money.
loan.zh: 我告诉汤姆我愿意借给他一些钱。

cousin.en: He isn't my brother. He's my cousin.
cousin.zh: 他不是我的兄弟。他是我的表弟。

experience.en: We're looking for someone who has experience in customer service.
experience.zh: 我们正在寻找具有客服工作经验的人。

rarely.en: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
rarely.zh: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。

unfit.en: He is unfit to be a teacher.

public.en: It is sometimes difficult to make yourself understood in public.
public.zh: 有时很难在公众场合表达你自己的意思。

ceiling.en: There's a big fly on the ceiling.
ceiling.zh: 有一只大苍蝇在天花板上。

merely.en: He said it merely as a joke.
merely.zh: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。

slave.en: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
slave.zh: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。

astronomy.en: What's the difference between astronomy and astrology?

germany.en: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
germany.zh: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

cottage.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
cottage.zh: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。

coast.en: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.
coast.zh: 大部分的学生来自西海岸。

view.en: As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
view.zh: 当我们走到转角处，湖就映入了眼帘。

resist.zh: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。

anger.en: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
anger.zh: 总理的发言估计激怒了在野党。

result.en: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.
result.zh: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。

selfish.en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
selfish.zh: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。

imply.en: I didn't mean to imply otherwise.

offend.en: I didn't mean to offend anyone.

exact.en: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
exact.zh: 你能否说出这个词的精确意思?

sincere.en: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
sincere.zh: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

punctual.en: Compared with her sister, she isn't very punctual.
punctual.zh: 与她的妹妹相比，她不是很准时。

interfere.en: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
interfere.zh: 你没有干涉他人事务的权力。

survive.en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
survive.zh: 那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

slight.en: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
slight.zh: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。

silver.en: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.

odd.en: One is the smallest odd number.

strawberry.zh: 我喜欢草莓味的冰淇淋。

neighborhood.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
neighborhood.zh: 上周的暴风雨损坏了我们社区的许多树木。

loss.en: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
loss.zh: 那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。

cliff.en: I nearly fell off the cliff.
cliff.zh: 我差点从悬崖上掉下去。

overtime.en: I had to work overtime yesterday.

model.en: I'd like to try out this new model before I buy it.
model.zh: 我想在买之前先试试这个新机型。

owner.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
owner.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

security.en: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
security.zh: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

sheer.en: It is a sheer waste of time.

brilliant.en: A brilliant future lay before him.
brilliant.zh: 大好的前途摆在他面前。

path.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
path.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

napkin.en: May I have a napkin, please?
napkin.zh: 请给我一张餐巾纸好吗？

positive.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.
positive.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。

grandson.en: My grandson is still a baby.

handwriting.en: Do you know whose handwriting this is?

betray.en: A true gentleman would not betray his friends.
betray.zh: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。

obviously.en: He can speak French, and obviously English.
obviously.zh: 他能说法语，当然还有英语。

author.en: Graham Greene is a favorite author of mine.
author.zh: 格雷厄姆葛林是我最喜欢的作家之一。

fax.en: I got your fax the other day.
fax.zh: 我前几天收到了你的传真。

prepare.en: Every morning she helps her mother to prepare breakfast in the kitchen.
prepare.zh: 她每天早上都帮母亲在厨房准备早餐。

safety.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
safety.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

typist.en: She found employment as a typist.

prophecy.en: She has a gift for prophecy.

badly.en: She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.
badly.zh: 当她的孩子在公共场合行为表现不好的时候，她觉得很尴尬。

gum.en: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
gum.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

explanation.en: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
explanation.zh: 这个解释不是很令人满意。

affair.en: I have nothing to do with the affair.

divine.en: To err is human, to forgive divine.

vast.en: The Sahara is a vast desert.

desert.en: The Sahara is a vast desert.

acid.en: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.

clown.en: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
clown.zh: 他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。

salmon.en: Salmon lay their eggs in fresh water.

ghost.en: You look like you've just seen a ghost.
ghost.zh: 你看起来就像见鬼了一样。

value.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
value.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

method.en: This method is sure to work.

attempt.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
attempt.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。

persuade.en: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.
persuade.zh: 说服他中止旅行真是件苦差事。

somewhat.en: Tom, Mary, John and Alice all looked somewhat surprised.
somewhat.zh: 汤姆、玛丽、约翰和爱丽丝都显得有些惊讶。

shape.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
shape.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。

parachute.zh: 汤姆的降落伞没有打开。

valuable.en: Neither Tom nor Mary has found anything valuable.
valuable.zh: 汤姆和玛丽都没有发现什么有价值的东西。

argue.en: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
argue.zh: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

relationship.en: I don't know anything about their relationship.
relationship.zh: 我对他们的关系一无所知。

period.en: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
period.zh: 在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。

somehow.en: We have to have fun somehow.

instantly.en: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.
instantly.zh: 汤姆被卡车撞到而且当场死亡。

further.en: The horse stopped and refused to go any further.
further.zh: 马停了下来，而且拒绝移动。

advise.en: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
advise.zh: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

sunset.en: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset?
sunset.zh: 你看过这么美的夕阳吗?

tortoise.en: A hare raced with a tortoise.

hare.en: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
hare.zh: 空手赤拳抓野兔并不容易。

mile.en: A mile is equal to about 1,600 meters.

vain.en: He endeavored to make his wife happy, but in vain.
vain.zh: 他试著想让他妻子开心，但是没有成功。

buddhism.en: Buddhism had its beginnings in India.

democracy.en: He doesn't have any knowledge about American democracy.
democracy.zh: 他一点都不知道美国的民主。

limit.en: My patience is nearing its limit.

dust.en: Probably you are allergic to pollen or dust.
dust.zh: 你可能对花粉或灰尘过敏。

pilot.en: My dream is to become a pilot.
pilot.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

cafeteria.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
cafeteria.zh: 餐厅的饭很便宜，而且很好吃。

engineer.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
engineer.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。

failure.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
failure.zh: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。

scholar.en: He is something of a scholar.

shelf.en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
shelf.zh: 她把她的CD在书架上排成一排。

arrow.en: The arrow indicates the way to go.

englishman.en: He mistook me for an Englishman.
englishman.zh: 他误认为我是一个英国人。

accustomed.en: He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.
accustomed.zh: 他很快就适应了新环境。

invaluable.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
invaluable.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

target.en: Her success made her the target of jealousy.
target.zh: 她的成功让她受尽嫉妒。

branch.en: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
branch.zh: 新的分店下个月在芝加哥开始营业。

disturb.en: I'll try not to disturb you while you're studying.
disturb.zh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。

involve.en: I didn't mean to involve you.
involve.zh: 我没想要让你牵扯进来。

bullet.en: I don't see any bullet holes.

polish.en: I got him to polish my shoes.

absolute.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
absolute.zh: 电脑现在是一个绝对必要的东西了。

lemon.en: Bring me a glass of tea with lemon.

slightly.en: The tower leaned slightly to the west.

cart.en: Don't put the cart before the horse.
cart.zh: 不要把马车放在马的前面。

swear.en: I could swear there's something inside this box.
swear.zh: 我能发誓这箱子里有东西。

divorce.en: Marriage is the main cause of divorce.
divorce.zh: 婚姻是造成离婚的主因。

dessert.en: I'm trying to save room for dessert.

behavior.en: Some people felt that Tom's behavior was inappropriate.
behavior.zh: 一部分人感觉Tom的行为举止不太合适。

merry.en: I wish you a Merry Christmas.

recovery.en: There is no hope of his recovery.

prescription.en: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
prescription.zh: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

industry.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
industry.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

railroad.en: The railroad is parallel to the road.

obligation.en: It is our obligation to help.

privilege.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
privilege.zh: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。

temper.en: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.
temper.zh: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。

leather.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
leather.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

puppy.en: This is the cutest puppy I've ever seen.
puppy.zh: 这是我见过最可爱的小狗。

burn.en: When you've finished reading this letter, burn it.
burn.zh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。

plastic.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
plastic.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

snack.en: What does Tom eat for a mid-afternoon snack?
snack.zh: 汤姆下午茶点心都吃什么？

kilogram.en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
kilogram.zh: 米以公斤为单位来出售。

personality.en: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
personality.zh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

jam.en: Please hide the blueberry jam where Takako can't see it.
jam.zh: 把蓝莓酱藏在享子看不到的地方。

object.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.
object.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。

leadership.zh: 汤姆天生具有领导能力。

traffic.en: You must be careful of the traffic when you cross the street.

conference.en: "Why are you going to Japan?" "To attend a conference in Tokyo."
conference.zh: “你去日本干嘛？”“去东京参加一个会议。”

worm.en: The early bird catches the worm.

awkward.en: The girl made an awkward bow.
awkward.zh: 这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

bow.en: The girl made an awkward bow.
bow.zh: 这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

sample.en: The sample is not pure enough.

sail.en: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.
sail.zh: 汤姆正在教我怎么开帆船。

total.en: What is the total amount of money you spent?

sock.en: You've got a big hole in your sock.

shortage.en: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
shortage.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

soul.en: The man sold his soul to the devil.

gentle.en: She gave the door a gentle push.

signature.en: I attached my signature to the document.

masterpiece.en: I think that Liszt's "Forgotten Waltz No.3" is a hidden masterpiece.
masterpiece.zh: 我觉得李斯特的《被遗忘的圆舞曲第三首》是个被埋没的名曲。

tune.en: She played a tune on the piano.
tune.zh: 她在钢琴上弹了一首曲子。

monk.en: Tom has decided to become a monk.

numerous.en: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.
numerous.zh: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。

former.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
former.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

photograph.en: My grandfather's photograph is on the wall.
photograph.zh: 我祖父的照片在墙上挂着。

blast.en: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
blast.zh: 收音机广播充斥著有关最近爆炸的新闻。

graduate.en: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
graduate.zh: 汤姆将在后年高中毕业。

infectious.zh: 汤姆的笑声很有感染力。

laughter.en: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
laughter.zh: 没有笑声的一天肯定是最为虚度的一天。

crime.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
crime.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。

dorm.en: Have you gotten used to living in the dorm?
dorm.zh: 你习惯在宿舍生活了吗？

judgement.en: We can rely on his judgement.
judgement.zh: 我们可以信赖他的判断。

connection.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
connection.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

conform.en: We must conform to the rules.

reduce.en: I have to reduce my expenses this month.

demand.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
demand.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

counter.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
counter.zh: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？

recover.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
recover.zh: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

moist.en: Winds from the sea are moist.
moist.zh: 从海洋吹来的风感觉湿漉漉的。

crowd.en: I heard someone in the crowd outside the station call my name.
crowd.zh: 我听到车站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。

scene.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
scene.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。

slavery.zh: 奴役制是一种危害人类罪。

arithmetic.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。

register.zh: 请您在登记册上签名好吗？

steal.en: Can you teach me how to steal?

tower.zh: 他们想在艾菲尔铁塔前面拍张结婚照。

insurance.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
insurance.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

silly.zh: 我必须问你一个蠢问题。

score.en: He got a better score than us.
score.zh: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。

steak.zh: 我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。

string.zh: 一连串的灾难袭击这个地区。

frighten.en: Scary movies will frighten the children.

least.en: When she was in Los Angeles, she had at least six different jobs.
least.zh: 当她在洛杉矶的时候, 她至少有六份工作。

particularly.en: The youngest daughter was particularly beautiful.

despite.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.
despite.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。

campus.en: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
campus.zh: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

charge.en: Is there a place where I can charge my cellphone around here?
charge.zh: 这附近有没有可以给手机充电的地方？

distance.en: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
distance.zh: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

subscribe.en: What newspaper do you subscribe to?

executive.en: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
executive.zh: 我们需要人力仲介公司帮我们找到合适的人来担任这个管理职位。

salesman.en: He makes a living as a salesman.

surrender.en: If Tom doesn't surrender, shoot him.
surrender.zh: 如果汤姆不投降，就开枪

climate.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
climate.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

millionaire.en: I'm going to be a millionaire.
millionaire.zh: 我就要成为百万富翁了。

naive.en: I'm surprised that you're so naive.
naive.zh: 我很惊讶你竟然那么天真。

lighter.en: Women eat lighter meals when they're eating with a guy.
lighter.zh: 当女性跟一个男人吃饭时，女性会吃得比较少。

cheat.en: It is wrong to cheat at cards.

reduction.en: He advocated the reduction of taxes.

partial.en: It was only a partial success.

root.en: Money is the root of all evil.

evil.en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
evil.zh: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。

airplane.en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
airplane.zh: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。

carpenter.en: The carpenter brought his tools along.

nephew.en: My nephew is allergic to eggs.

vitamin.en: Carrots contain a lot of vitamin A.
vitamin.zh: 胡萝卜中含有大量的维生素A。

outdoors.en: The party will be held outdoors, weather permitting.
outdoors.zh: 若天气许可的话，派对将会在户外举行。

temptation.en: You shouldn't give in to temptation.
temptation.zh: 你不应该屈服在诱惑之下。

meaningful.en: She gave me a meaningful look.
meaningful.zh: 她意味深长地看了我一眼。

compact.en: She gave me this compact disc.

relief.en: This medicine will give you some relief.

crawl.en: She knows how to do the crawl.

pocket.en: The kitchen knife wasn't sharp enough to cut the meat, so I used my pocket knife.
pocket.zh: 这把菜刀不够锋利，所以我用了我的折叠刀来切肉。

museum.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
museum.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

clinic.en: She went to the Takasu clinic.

wireless.en: Should I buy a wireless mouse?
wireless.zh: 要不要买个无线鼠标呢？

incident.en: The incident made everyone feel more embarrassed.
incident.zh: 这件事弄得大家都比较尴尬。

van.en: Tom was the last one to get in the van.
van.zh: 汤姆是最后一个上面包车的。

diet.en: We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
diet.zh: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。

argument.en: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
argument.zh: 经过长久的争论，我终于说服了她去露营。

barber.en: A barber is a man who shaves and cuts men's hair.
barber.zh: 理发师是为男人刮胡子和剪头发的人。

gay.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
gay.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。

capital.en: A capital letter is used at the beginning of a sentence.
capital.zh: 一个句子以一个大写字母开始。

hedge.en: The cat got through the hedge.

successful.en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.
successful.zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。

experiment.en: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.
experiment.zh: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。

prey.en: The lion is stalking its prey.

robot.en: How could I be a robot? Robots can't dream.
robot.zh: 我怎么可能是机器人呢？机器人不会做梦。

horizon.en: The sun went below the horizon.

topic.en: I chose this topic because I think that it's interesting.
topic.zh: 我选这个主题是因为我觉得它很有意思。

activity.en: Watching TV is a passive activity.
activity.zh: 看电视是一种被动的活动。

island.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
island.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

insist.en: They insist that he should go.

separate.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
separate.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。

continue.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.
continue.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请务必注意食物中毒。

recorder.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
recorder.zh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

tape.en: He erased his speech from the tape.
tape.zh: 他把他的那段话从磁带里删除了。

sake.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.

tough.en: Tom certainly has a tough job.
tough.zh: 汤姆确实有个麻烦的工作。

electrical.en: Keep away from the electrical equipment.

balance.en: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
balance.zh: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。

tail.en: Better be the head of a cat than the tail of a lion.

waist.en: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
waist.zh: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

translate.en: It took me more than two hours to translate a few pages of English.
translate.zh: 翻译几页英文花了我2个多小时。

appeal.en: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
appeal.zh: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。

confuse.zh: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。

canoe.en: We went down a river by canoe.
canoe.zh: 我们乘著独木舟向河的下游而行。

width.en: What's the width of this road?

embassy.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
embassy.zh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。

burglar.en: The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
burglar.zh: 警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

rat.en: A cornered rat will bite a cat.

typhoon.en: Because of the typhoon, my parents ended their trip one day early.
typhoon.zh: 因为台风的关系，我的父母提早一天结束了旅行回到家。

algebra.zh: 代数是我最喜欢的科目。

physician.en: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.
physician.zh: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。

politics.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
politics.zh: 很多日本人对政治冷淡。

objection.en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
objection.zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

slippery.en: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
slippery.zh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

pronounce.en: Is there anyone who can pronounce this word?

barley.en: Can you tell wheat from barley?
barley.zh: 你能辨别小麦和大麦吗？

compare.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
compare.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

license.en: My mother has a driver's license, but she doesn't drive a car.
license.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。

steady.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
steady.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。

realize.en: Life begins when we realize who we really are.
realize.zh: 当我们明白真正的自己时，生活开始了。

desire.en: There are no people who don't desire peace.

magazine.en: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
magazine.zh: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。

translation.en: Which translation of this book do you think is better, the French one or the English one?
translation.zh: 你觉得这本书的哪个译本比较好？法语的还是英语的？

scarf.en: Tom tried to convince Mary to knit him a scarf.
scarf.zh: 汤姆想说服玛丽给他织一条围巾。

pool.en: If you stay at a big hotel, you can use their swimming pool.
pool.zh: 若你住到的是大的旅馆，就能使用他们的游泳池。

scholarship.en: Tom was able to go to college thanks to a scholarship.
scholarship.zh: 因为一份奖学金，Tom得以上大学。

purpose.en: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.
purpose.zh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。

scarcely.en: She had scarcely finished speaking when he cut in.
scarcely.zh: 她几乎没有说完话，就被他打断了。

trace.zh: 他没有留下痕迹就消失了。

signal.en: He gave us the signal to begin.
signal.zh: 他给了我们开始的信号。

policy.en: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
policy.zh: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

finding.en: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
finding.zh: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。

grasp.en: He has a good grasp of English.

thoughtful.en: She is very thoughtful and patient.

behalf.en: He is acting on his own behalf.

shadow.en: She is afraid of her own shadow.

blink.en: How many times a minute does the average person blink?
blink.zh: 人平均一分钟眨几次眼睛？

fantasy.en: He lives in a world of fantasy.
fantasy.zh: 他住在一个奇幻世界里。

emergency.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
emergency.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

ambition.en: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
ambition.zh: 以前，玛丽想和一位有雄心壮志的男人结婚。

aware.en: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
aware.zh: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。

director.en: They appointed him as a director.

associate.en: We often associate black with death.
associate.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。

popular.en: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
popular.zh: 在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。

scientific.en: Dr. Yukawa played an important part in the scientific study.
scientific.zh: 汤川博士在科学研究上起了很重要的作用。

roast.en: How about some more roast beef?
roast.zh: 再多一些烤牛肉怎么样?

italian.en: One is Japanese and the other is Italian.
italian.zh: 一个是日本人，另一个是意大利人。

rainbow.en: Did you see the rainbow this morning?
rainbow.zh: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？

issue.en: How do you feel about the issue?
issue.zh: 你对这个问题有甚么感受？

unnecessary.en: If two men always have the same opinion, one of them is unnecessary.
unnecessary.zh: 如果两个人总是意见相同，那么他们其中一个就没必要了。

predict.en: It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.
predict.zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

embarrass.en: I didn't mean to embarrass you.

emotional.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
emotional.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

insult.en: Tom didn't mean to insult anybody.

overwhelm.en: I didn't mean to overwhelm you.
overwhelm.zh: 我没有想要让你不知所措。

process.en: The whole process will take months.
process.zh: 整个过程需要耗费数月。

faint.en: I feel like I'm going to faint.

coin.en: I found a coin on the sidewalk.
coin.zh: 我在人行道上发现了一枚硬币。

survival.en: I gave up all hope of survival.
survival.zh: 我放弃了所有生存的希望。

tightly.en: I hugged him tightly and cried.

appointment.en: Make another appointment at the front desk.

reputation.en: It's hard to maintain one's reputation.
reputation.zh: 维持一个人的声誉是很难的。

stake.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
stake.zh: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。

compliment.en: I'll take that as a compliment.

palm.en: I am interested in palm reading.
palm.zh: 我对掌上阅读很感兴趣。

plain.en: Could you say that in plain English?

saving.en: His parents are saving for his college education.
saving.zh: 他的父母为他的大学教育存钱。

ridge.en: Is this the bus for Park Ridge?
ridge.zh: 这是去帕克里奇的巴士？

lighten.en: It was just a joke. Lighten up!

environmental.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
environmental.zh: 环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。

orbit.en: It takes 165 years for Neptune to orbit around the sun.
orbit.zh: 海王星绕行太阳一周要花一百六十五年。

priest.en: My brother has become a priest.
priest.zh: 我的兄弟已经成为了牧师。

artistic.en: He was raised in an artistic family.

weep.en: My mother did nothing but weep.
weep.zh: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。

adopt.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
adopt.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

precious.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.
precious.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。

yacht.en: Our yacht club has ten members.
yacht.zh: 我们的游艇俱乐部里有十个会员。

scrap.en: Please get me a scrap of paper.

tool.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.
tool.zh: 你会需要一个特殊的工具来做这件事。

liar.en: A liar needs to have a good memory.
liar.zh: 说谎的人需要很好的记忆力。

nerve.en: She had the nerve to speak out.

pack.en: She helped me pack my suitcase.
pack.zh: 她帮我打包我的手提箱。

various.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
various.zh: 日本从国外进口各种原料。

regularly.en: Are you taking any medicine regularly?
regularly.zh: 你经常服用任何药物吗？

verge.en: The poor child was on the verge of starvation.
verge.zh: 那可怜的孩子快饿死了。

within.en: The school is located within five minutes' walk of the station.
within.zh: 学校坐落于距离车站步行五分钟的地方。

strictly.en: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
strictly.zh: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

humid.en: It is extremely hot and humid in Bali in December.
humid.zh: 12月份巴厘岛极其炎热和潮湿。

capacity.en: The room has a seating capacity of 200.

criminal.en: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
criminal.zh: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。

construction.en: A new school building is under construction.
construction.zh: 一座新的教学楼正在建设。

bud.en: The trees are beginning to bud.

hail.en: There's no need to hail a taxi.

series.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
series.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

intersection.en: Turn right at the next intersection.
intersection.zh: 请在下一个十字路口右转。

product.en: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.
product.zh: 舅舅的公司上个月推出了一款新产品。

jar.en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.

professional.en: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.
professional.zh: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

software.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
software.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。

shift.en: Tom is working the night shift.

strict.en: It's important to follow a strict diet.
strict.zh: 重要的是要遵循严格的饮食控制。

electric.en: I should have tried out this electric shaver before buying it.
electric.zh: 我本该在买下这个电动剃须刀之前试一下的。

permission.en: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.

mild.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
mild.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

personal.en: Tom doesn't care about protecting his personal information online.
personal.zh: 汤姆上网时并不在乎个人资讯的保护。

formal.en: There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
formal.zh: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。

editor.en: You don't want to be an editor?

direction.en: You have a really good sense of direction.

consult.en: I don't know who to consult with.
consult.zh: 我不知道该和谁商量好。

extreme.en: Your proposal is a bit extreme.

penny.en: A penny saved is a penny earned.
penny.zh: 省下了一分钱，就等于赚了一分钱。

moss.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

eclipse.en: Did you see the eclipse yesterday?
eclipse.zh: 你看了昨天的月蚀了吗？

commute.en: Do you commute to school by bus?

conscience.en: Do you have a guilty conscience?

declare.en: Do you have anything to declare?
declare.zh: 你有任何要申报的东西吗？

keen.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.

hesitate.en: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
hesitate.zh: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。

lining.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.

potential.en: Every man is a potential corpse.
potential.zh: 每个人都可能变成尸体。

grammar.en: In Esperanto there are only 16 grammar rules.
grammar.zh: 世界语只有16个语法规则。

loaf.en: I just remembered that I was supposed to buy a loaf of bread.
loaf.zh: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。

degree.en: He got a master's degree in law.
degree.zh: 他得到了法律硕士学位。

imaginative.en: He used to be an imaginative boy.
imaginative.zh: 他曾经是一个富有想像力的男孩。

cozy.en: He lives in a cozy little house.
cozy.zh: 他住在一个舒适的小房子里。

poster.en: He paused to look at the poster.

century.en: Islam first reached China about the middle of the 7th century.
century.zh: 伊斯兰教大约在七世纪中传到中国。

severe.en: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
severe.zh: 日本正面临著严重的经济问题。

brain.zh: 他是一个优秀的脑外科医生。

surgeon.zh: 他是一个优秀的脑外科医生。

teaching.en: I don't think that Tom has any teaching experience.
teaching.zh: 我认为汤姆一点教学经验都没有。

earn.en: Money takes a long time to earn, but you can spend it in no time.
earn.zh: 钱要花很长的时间来赚, 但你可以一下子就花掉它了。

extent.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.
extent.zh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。

toad.en: I cannot distinguish a frog from a toad.
toad.zh: 我无法区分青蛙和蟾蜍。

discourage.en: I didn't mean to discourage you.

mislead.en: I didn't want to mislead anyone.

hopeful.en: I feel hopeful about the future.

rapidly.en: I felt my heart beating rapidly.
rapidly.zh: 我感觉我的心跳得很快。

column.zh: 我发现这个专栏很有趣。

calendar.en: She hung the calendar on the wall.

injection.en: I need to give you an injection.

explode.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

phrase.en: What's the meaning of this phrase?

kindness.en: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
kindness.zh: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。

lens.en: I'm looking for my contact lens.

response.en: I'm sorry for the late response.

chip.en: Tom baked some chocolate chip cookies.
chip.zh: 汤姆烤了些巧克力脆饼。

unlike.en: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
unlike.zh: 不像狗, 这只鹤从来没有梦想过飞翔。

justice.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

swift.en: Life is short and time is swift.

tube.en: Please buy a tube of toothpaste.

department.en: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
department.zh: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百货公司的特价活动。

supply.en: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
supply.zh: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。

ocean.en: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
ocean.zh: Charles Lindbergh于1927年成功完成了第一次独自飞越大西洋。

ease.en: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
ease.zh: 我面对陌生人很不自在。

pebble.en: She stooped to pick up a pebble.

walnut.en: He cracked the walnut with his teeth.

population.en: By the year 2020, the population of our city will have doubled.
population.zh: 在2020年以前，我们的城市的人口将增加一倍。

compass.en: Compass needles point to the north.
compass.zh: 指南针的指针指向北边。

mat.en: Entering the house, I tripped over the mat.
mat.zh: 进家门后，我被垫子绊倒了。

gang.en: The gang was planning a robbery.

due.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
due.zh: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。

theft.en: The police accused him of theft.

narrow.en: The gate is so narrow that the car can't pass through it.
narrow.zh: 门太窄了，这辆车通不过。

strain.en: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.

scent.en: The scent of cedar repels moths.
scent.zh: 雪松的气味可以驱赶飞蛾。

thunder.en: Lightning is usually followed by thunder.

complaint.en: There is no cause for complaint.

helicopter.en: Tom and Mary are both helicopter pilots.
helicopter.zh: 汤姆和玛丽都是直升机飞行员。

data.en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
data.zh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

adequate.en: This meal is adequate for three.

pamphlet.en: This pamphlet is free of charge.

foster.en: This song was written by Foster.

habit.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

indeed.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

absence.en: Her absence went unnoticed until the end of the meeting.
absence.zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

accuracy.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。

destination.en: They made straight for their destination.

distinguish.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
distinguish.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

transmission.en: Can you drive a manual transmission?

meadow.en: Cows are eating grass in the meadow.

melon.en: Cut the melon into six equal pieces.

compound.en: Do you know what compound words are?
compound.zh: 你知道什么是复合词吗？

sadness.en: Do you know what sadness feels like?

leak.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
leak.zh: 这场爆炸有可能是瓦斯外泄引起的。

communication.en: English is a means of communication.
communication.zh: 英语是一种沟通的手段。

statue.en: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
statue.zh: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。

mature.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
mature.zh: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

opportunity.en: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
opportunity.zh: 你所要做的便是好好把握这千载难逢的机会。

religion.en: I am interested in Chinese religion.

confirm.en: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
confirm.zh: 我既不能确认也不能否定。

recall.en: I can't recall the last time we met.
recall.zh: 我想不起来我们上次见面的情况了。

dialog.en: I did not participate in the dialog.

roller.en: Which do you enjoy more, ice skating or roller skating?
roller.zh: 你更喜欢滑冰还是轮滑？

collection.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
collection.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

improve.en: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
improve.zh: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

amateur.en: I was still an amateur at that time.

purchase.en: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
purchase.zh: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

invite.en: I'd like to invite you to the party.

adapt.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.

restless.en: I've been feeling a little restless.

satisfy.en: It is difficult to satisfy everyone.

density.en: Japan has a high population density.

dye.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
dye.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

crew.en: Modern ships only need a small crew.
crew.zh: 现代船只只需要一小组的船员。

understanding.en: Tom and Mary came to an understanding.
understanding.zh: 汤姆和玛丽达成了协议。

mutual.en: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
mutual.zh: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。

vary.en: Social customs vary from country to country.

pour.en: Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
pour.zh: 将融化了的奶油倒入爆米花中。

princess.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

globe.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.
globe.zh: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。

overcome.en: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.
overcome.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。

spelling.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
spelling.zh: 你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。

humanity.en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
humanity.zh: 奴役制是一种危害人类罪。

golden.en: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.

broadcast.en: That program is now being broadcast.
broadcast.zh: 那个节目现在正在播出。

consideration.en: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
consideration.zh: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

alphabet.en: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
alphabet.zh: 我记得我母亲教我认字。

revolution.en: After the revolution, France became a republic.
revolution.zh: 革命之后，法国成为了一个共和国。

x-ray.en: The X-ray showed two broken fingers.
x-ray.zh: X光片显示两根手指断了。

parcel.en: The address on this parcel is wrong.
parcel.zh: 这个包裹上的地址是错的。

calculator.en: The batteries in my calculator are dead.
calculator.zh: 我计算机的电池没电了。

despise.en: The rich sometimes despise the poor.
despise.zh: 富人有时会看不起穷人。

radar.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.

volcano.en: The volcano has become active again.
volcano.zh: 这座火山又开始活动了。

partly.en: The wall is partly covered with ivy.
partly.zh: 墙被常青藤覆盖了一部分。

thoroughly.en: Because Tom didn't thoroughly clean the pots, Mary got dysentery.
thoroughly.zh: 汤姆没有彻底清洗锅碗瓢盆，导致玛莉得了痢疾。

applicable.en: This law is applicable to all cases.

genuine.en: This might not be a genuine diamond.

valid.en: It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.

application.en: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
application.zh: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

accent.en: Where is the accent on the word 'Australia?'

toast.en: I always have coffee and toast for breakfast.
toast.zh: 我的早餐总是咖啡和土司。

screen.en: Tom became popular among teenagers as soon as he made his debut on the screen.
screen.zh: 汤姆第一次上电视后就广受青少年的欢迎。

solid.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
solid.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

range.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.
range.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。

penalty.en: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
penalty.zh: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

abolish.en: We should abolish the death penalty.

yawn.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
yawn.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

explosion.en: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.
explosion.zh: 昨晚，烟花厂发生了爆炸。

booth.en: Tom ran and ran, until at last he saw the telephone booth.
booth.zh: 汤姆跑啊跑, 直到他终于看到了电话亭。

wipe.en: Wipe the pan dry with a paper towel.

classical.en: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.
classical.zh: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

composition.en: I had my composition corrected by the teacher.
composition.zh: 我把我的作文拿给老师订正。

phenomenon.en: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.

senior.en: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
senior.zh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

constant.en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
constant.zh: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。

garbage.en: Don't forget to take out the garbage.

heaven.en: My father always said that heaven helps those who help themselves.
heaven.zh: 我父亲总是说天助自助者。

culture.en: The students are talking about language and culture.
culture.zh: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。

gently.en: He put his hand gently on her shoulder.
gently.zh: 他把他的手温柔地放在她的肩上。

verse.en: He translated the verse into English.

unify.en: He tried to unify the various groups.
unify.zh: 他试著统一不同的团体。

deputy.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
deputy.zh: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。

stir.en: I don't want to stir up old memories.
stir.zh: 我不愿意勾起久远的回忆。

previous.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.
previous.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

convince.en: Tom told Mary not to waste her time trying to convince John to help.
convince.zh: 汤姆对玛丽说，不要浪费时间去说服约翰来帮忙。

position.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
position.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

focus.en: I can't focus on two things at the same time.
focus.zh: 我不能同时注意两件事。

prairie.en: Laura Ingalls grew up on the prairie.
prairie.zh: 劳拉英戈尔斯是在草原上长大的。

industrial.en: Many people work in industrial towns.
industrial.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。

sorrow.en: No words can express her deep sorrow.

relieve.en: No words can relieve her deep sorrow.
relieve.zh: 语言不能减轻她的悲痛。

conduct.en: One must be responsible for one's conduct.
conduct.zh: 人要为自己的行为负责。

sink.en: She put the dirty dishes in the sink.
sink.zh: 她把脏盘子放进水池里。

material.en: She is collecting material for a book.

dependent.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
dependent.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

record.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
record.zh: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界纪录。

traditional.en: Their traditional life style no longer exists.
traditional.zh: 他们传统的生活方式不再存在。

scandal.en: That scandal cost him his reputation.
scandal.zh: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。

length.en: The length of this ship is 30 meters.

shell.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
shell.zh: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

framework.en: The whole framework was made of iron.
framework.zh: 整个框架由铁金属制成。

beyond.en: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
beyond.zh: 你看过富士山吗? 它美得无法形容。

bamboo.en: There's bamboo growing in the garden.

possibility.en: There's a possibility that you'll have to do that.
possibility.zh: 你有可能不得不那么做。

increase.en: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
increase.zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

guarantee.en: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
guarantee.zh: 我不能确保这一切会发生。

atomic.en: They know how to make an atomic bomb.
atomic.zh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。

bomb.en: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
bomb.zh: 在伦敦，警察总是担心在列车或地铁上发现炸弹。

paradise.en: The island is a paradise for children.
paradise.zh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。

tent.en: It took us half an hour to set up the tent.
tent.zh: 搭帐篷花了我们半小时。

normally.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
normally.zh: 句子通常有主词和动词。

eloquent.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
eloquent.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

investment.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
investment.zh: 他们在这次的投资中得到百分之八的收益。

microphone.en: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
microphone.zh: 刚才我的麦克风没起作用，不知道为什么。

dome.en: What's the number for the Tokyo Dome?
dome.zh: 东京巨蛋的电话号码是多少？

tunnel.en: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
tunnel.zh: 这条隧道是那条的两倍长。

convey.en: Wires are used to convey electricity.

device.en: You should have shown him the device.
device.zh: 你应该给他看看这装置。

critical.en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
critical.zh: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

panel.en: A panel of experts discussed the plan.
panel.zh: 一个专家小组讨论这个计划。

stove.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
stove.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

distract.en: Don't distract me while I am studying.
distract.zh: 我学习的时候不要打扰我。

bleach.en: Don't mix ammonia and bleach together.
bleach.zh: 别把氨水和漂白剂混在一起。

upon.en: While we were discussing the problem, I hit upon a good idea.
upon.zh: 在我们讨论问题的过程中，我想到了一个好主意。

thesis.en: Have you finished writing your thesis?

concentrate.en: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
concentrate.zh: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。

mute.en: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and mute.
mute.zh: 海伦·凯勒眼盲、耳聋并且不能说话。

crisis.en: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
crisis.zh: 在危险的时候你必须跟你的老师联系。

retirement.en: His life after retirement was unhappy.
retirement.zh: 他退休后的生活不快乐。

pronunciation.en: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
pronunciation.zh: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

aboard.en: How many people were aboard that ship?

irregular.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.
irregular.zh: 我不喜欢学习不规则动词。

resume.en: I don't worry so much about my resume.
resume.zh: 我对自己的履历不那么在意。

dim.en: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.
dim.zh: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。

impression.en: You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
impression.zh: 你永远没有第二次机会去打造第一印象。

advocate.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

delay.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
delay.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

general.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
general.zh: 一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。

souvenir.en: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.
souvenir.zh: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。

sometime.en: I hope we'll see each other again sometime.
sometime.zh: 我希望我们有时间还可以见面。

permanent.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

queen.en: Queen Elizabeth I passed away in 1603.
queen.zh: 女王伊丽莎白一世于1603年去世。

vulgar.en: She is extremely vulgar in her speech.

row.en: A beautiful woman was seated one row in front of me.
row.zh: 一个美丽的女人坐在我前面一排。

current.en: An electric current can generate magnetism.

operate.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

importance.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

span.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.

bribe.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.

slope.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
slope.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

steep.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
steep.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

adjacent.en: The stadium is adjacent to the school.

district.en: The typhoon struck the Kanto district.

tone.en: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.
tone.zh: 他不知道他自己五音不全。

vacant.en: There were several rooms still vacant.

membership.en: I applied for membership in the association.

decrease.en: This medicine will decrease your pain.
decrease.zh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。

apply.en: What Tom said doesn't apply in this situation.

astonishment.en: To my astonishment, my money was gone.
astonishment.zh: 令我惊讶的是，我的钱没了。

organic.en: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
organic.zh: 汤姆和玛丽拥有一个小型的有机农场。

unpleasant.en: We had an unpleasant experience there.
unpleasant.zh: 我们在那里有一个不愉快的经历。

ample.en: We have ample time to catch our train.
ample.zh: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。

prevent.en: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
prevent.zh: 你想要知道如何避免皱纹吗？

theme.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?
theme.zh: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？

item.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
item.zh: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。

destiny.en: Everyone ought to be the master of his own destiny.
destiny.zh: 每个人都应该做自己命运的主人。

colony.en: Some say that China was like a Russian colony.
colony.zh: 有人说中国像是俄国的殖民地。

urge.en: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
urge.zh: 广告怂恿我们买奢侈品。

kit.en: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.

inch.en: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.

remarkable.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
remarkable.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。

seaside.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
seaside.zh: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

forehead.en: The scar on his forehead is conspicuous.
forehead.zh: 他额头上的疤痕很醒目。

ambassador.en: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.

firm.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
firm.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

astonish.en: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
astonish.zh: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

conceive.en: I can't conceive of living without him.
conceive.zh: 我无法想像生命中没有他。

tolerate.en: I can't tolerate this noise any longer.
tolerate.zh: 我不能再忍受这个噪音了。

annual.en: I don't know my father's annual income.
annual.zh: 我不知到我爸的年收入是多少。

shore.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
shore.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。

farewell.en: I got a farewell present from everyone.
farewell.zh: 每个人都送了我一份欢送礼物。

refusal.en: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
refusal.zh: 我认为她的沉默就是表示拒绝。

roman.en: I'm looking for books on Roman history.
roman.zh: 我在找关于古罗马历史的书。

inflation.en: Interest rates and inflation were high.

maintain.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
maintain.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

belief.en: It's my belief that knowledge is power.

concrete.en: Looking down, we saw a concrete jungle.
concrete.zh: 我们往下看，是一片水泥丛林。

spray.en: Mary carries pepper spray in her purse.
spray.zh: 玛丽的包里有辣椒喷雾。

voyage.en: Mary went on a voyage around the world.

state.en: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
state.zh: 纽约帝国大厦现在完全依靠风力发电。

instant.en: Right at that instant, the bus stopped.
instant.zh: 就在那时，公交车停住了。

decay.en: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
decay.zh: 盐可以帮助保存食物避免腐烂。

preserve.en: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
preserve.zh: 盐可以帮助保存食物避免腐烂。

slip.en: This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
slip.zh: 这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。

indicate.en: Smiles do not always indicate pleasure.
indicate.zh: 微笑并不一定表示高兴。

foreigner.en: A foreigner came up to me and asked me for money.
foreigner.zh: 一个外国人找到我，管我要钱。

satellite.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.
satellite.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。

tow.en: The policeman didn't tow your car away.

approach.en: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
approach.zh: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。

canal.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
canal.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。

tomato.en: The tomato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
tomato.zh: 番茄是蔬菜而不是水果。

trade.en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.

quality.en: I'd gladly pay more for something if it's of high quality.
quality.zh: 如果它是高品质的东西我会很乐意多付一点钱。

atmosphere.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
atmosphere.zh: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

mysterious.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
mysterious.zh: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

obstinate.en: He became more obstinate as he grew older.
obstinate.zh: 他年纪越大变得越顽固。

ultraviolet.zh: 平流层的臭氧会吸收紫外线。

cycle.en: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
cycle.zh: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。

lack.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
lack.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

preparation.en: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
preparation.zh: 我们因缺乏准备而失败了。

considerate.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
considerate.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。

trick.en: You're not trying to trick me, are you?

necessity.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
necessity.zh: 电脑现在是一个绝对必要的东西了。

spark.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

wreck.en: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
wreck.zh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。

region.en: A string of disasters struck the region.
region.zh: 一连串的灾难袭击这个地区。

continent.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
continent.zh: 哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。

bar.en: If you sang, they'd kick you out of the bar.
bar.zh: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧。

gravity.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
gravity.zh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
